DocName : { line : U64, module_part : Str, name : Str, is_others : Bool }

## The file's stale names, and what the run has read of names since.
file_findings! : DocNames.FileRead, DocNames.Seen => { found : List(Finding), seen : DocNames.Seen }
file_findings! = |file, seen_before| {
	var $seen = seen_before
	own = match seen_before.by_path.get(file.path) {
		Ok(Read(names)) => names
		_ => names_in_tree(file.nodes)
	}
	base = Text.basename(file.path)
	folder = Str.from_utf8_lossy(file.path.to_utf8().take_first(file.path.count_utf8_bytes() - base.count_utf8_bytes()))
	own_module = Tree.module_name(file.path)
	is_platform = file.nodes.any(|node| node.kind == "platform")
	var $imported = []
	var $all_imports_known = Bool.True
	for imported in imports_in_tree(file.nodes) {
		looked = module_names!(folder, imported, $seen)
		$seen = looked.seen
		match looked.names {
			Ok(names) => {
				$imported = $imported.append(names)
			}
			Err(Unknown) => {
				$all_imports_known = Bool.False
			}
		}
	}
	var $said = Set.empty()
	var $found = []
	for doc_name in doc_names_in(file.source_lines, $seen.sources) {
		name = doc_name.name
		plain = name.drop_suffix("!")
		holds = |names| names.contains(name) or names.contains(plain)
		is_host_symbol = is_platform and plain.starts_with("roc_")
		is_bare = doc_name.module_part == ""
		var $judged = !(is_bare and (doc_name.is_others or !($all_imports_known) or is_host_symbol))
		var $names_something = Bool.False
		if is_bare or doc_name.module_part == own_module {
			if holds(own) or $seen.known.contains(plain) {
				$names_something = Bool.True
			}
			if is_bare and $imported.any(holds) {
				$names_something = Bool.True
			}
		} else {
			looked = module_names!(folder, doc_name.module_part, $seen)
			$seen = looked.seen
			match looked.names {
				Ok(names) => {
					if holds(names) {
						$names_something = Bool.True
					}
				}
				Err(Unknown) => {
					$judged = Bool.False
				}
			}
		}
		shown = if is_bare {
			name
		} else {
			"${doc_name.module_part}.${name}"
		}
		key = "${doc_name.line.to_str()}|${shown}"
		if $judged and !($names_something) and !($said.contains(key)) {
			$said = $said.insert(key)
			place = if is_bare {
				"this file or its imports"
			} else {
				doc_name.module_part
			}
			what = "a comment names `${shown}`, which names nothing in ${place}: a rename left it behind, or it names what is gone"
			$found = $found.append({ path: file.path, line: doc_name.line, check: "stale_doc_name", what })
		}
	}
	{ found: $found, seen: $seen }
}

## The names module `module` holds, or `Unknown` when they can't be known
## (a builtin's module, a package's the run didn't read): those of
## `<folder><module>.roc` beside the file, read once, else those of the
## files read that hold a module of that name.
module_names! : Str, Str, DocNames.Seen => { names : Try(Set(Str), [Unknown]), seen : DocNames.Seen }
module_names! = |folder, module_named, seen| {
	path = "${folder}${module_named}.roc"
	looked_up = match seen.by_path.get(path) {
		Ok(known) => { read: known, after: seen }
		Err(_) => {
			read_now = if Shale.exists!(path) {
				match Shale.roc_tree!([path]) {
					[parsed, ..] if parsed.err == "" => Read(names_in_tree(parsed.nodes))
					_ => Unread
				}
			} else {
				Unread
			}
			{ read: read_now, after: { ..seen, by_path: seen.by_path.insert(path, read_now) } }
		}
	}
	read = looked_up.read
	after = looked_up.after
	names = match read {
		Read(names_read) => Ok(names_read)
		Unread =>
			match seen.by_module.get(module_named) {
				Ok(names_held) => Ok(names_held)
				Err(_) => Err(Unknown)
			}
	}
	{ names, seen: after }
}

## Every name a file's tree holds: what it declares, binds, calls, each
## record field and method it names, and each symbol a platform's
## `provides` gives the host, with and without an effect's `!`.
names_in_tree : List(Tree.Node) -> Set(Str)
names_in_tree = |nodes| {
	var $names = Set.empty()
	for node in nodes {
		for attribute in node.attributes {
			if ["raw", "name", "field", "method", "symbol"].contains(attribute.name) {
				value = attribute.value.drop_prefix(".")
				if value != "" {
					$names = $names.insert(value)
					if value.ends_with("!") {
						$names = $names.insert(value.drop_suffix("!"))
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	$names
}

## The modules a file imports, by the name its code calls them (`Route`,
## and `Stdout` for `pf.Stdout`).
imports_in_tree : List(Tree.Node) -> List(Str)
imports_in_tree = |nodes|
	nodes.keep_if(|node| node.kind == "s-import").map(|node| Tree.last_part(Tree.attribute(node, "raw")))

## A file's extensions, so `Screen.roc` is a file's name, not a member's.
file_extensions : List(Str)
file_extensions = ["roc", "md", "txt", "zig", "ts", "js", "mjs", "json", "shale", "html", "tsv"]

## Each backticked name in the comment lines of a file (`#` or `##` first),
## as the header says which are judged.
doc_names_in : List(Str), Set(Str) -> List(DocName)
doc_names_in = |source_lines, sources| {
	var $out = []
	$number : U64
	var $number = 0
	for source_line in source_lines {
		$number = $number + 1
		line = Text.trim(source_line)
		if line.starts_with("#") {
			for span in backticked(line) {
				match doc_name_parts(span.text) {
					Ok(parts) => {
						before_on_line = Text.trim(without_hashes(Text.bytes_of(line, { start: 0, count: span.at })))
						before = if before_on_line == "" and $number > 1 {
							Text.trim(Text.line_at(source_lines, $number - 1))
						} else {
							before_on_line
						}
						is_others = is_possessive("${before} ") or cites_source(sentence_before(source_lines, $number, span.at), sources)
						is_file = parts.module_part != "" and file_extensions.contains(parts.name)
						if (parts.module_part != "" or parts.name.contains("_")) and !(is_file) {
							$out = $out.append({ line: $number, module_part: parts.module_part, name: parts.name, is_others })
						}
					}
					Err(NoName) => {}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	$out
}

## Each run between two backticks with something between them, left to
## right: `at` is how many bytes stand before its opening backtick.
backticked : Str -> List({ at : U64, text : Str })
backticked = |line| {
	bytes = line.to_utf8()
	var $spans = []
	$at : U64
	var $at = 0
	while $at < bytes.len() {
		if bytes.get($at) == Ok('`') {
			rest = bytes.drop_first($at + 1)
			match rest.find_first_index(|byte| byte == '`') {
				Ok(0) => {
					$at = $at + 1
				}
				Ok(length) => {
					$spans = $spans.append({ at: $at, text: Str.from_utf8_lossy(rest.take_first(length)) })
					$at = $at + length + 2
				}
				Err(_) => {
					$at = bytes.len()
				}
			}
		} else {
			$at = $at + 1
		}
	}
	$spans
}

## A backticked text's module and name when it is a doc name:
## `two_opt`, `read_line!`, `Route.two_opt(stops)`
## (the Shale original's DOC_NAME).
doc_name_parts : Str -> Try({ module_part : Str, name : Str }, [NoName])
doc_name_parts = |text| {
	bytes = text.to_utf8()
	match bytes {
		[first, .. as rest] if Text.is_capital(first) => {
			module_length = 1 + (rest.find_first_index(|byte| !(is_letter_or_digit(byte))) ?? rest.len())
			if bytes.get(module_length) != Ok('.') {
				return Err(NoName)
			}
			name = name_of(bytes.drop_first(module_length + 1))?
			Ok({ module_part: Str.from_utf8_lossy(bytes.take_first(module_length)), name })
		}
		_ => Ok({ module_part: "", name: name_of(bytes)? })
	}
}

## The name a doc name's bytes start with, `[a-z][a-z0-9]*(_[a-z0-9]+)*!?`,
## when nothing or a call's parentheses follow it.
name_of : List(U8) -> Try(Str, [NoName])
name_of = |bytes| {
	is_word_byte = |byte| Text.is_small_letter(byte) or Text.is_digit(byte)
	match bytes.first() {
		Ok(first) if Text.is_small_letter(first) => {}
		_ => return Err(NoName)
	}
	$length : U64
	var $length = 1
	while $length < bytes.len() and is_word_byte(bytes.get($length) ?? 0) {
		$length = $length + 1
	}
	while bytes.get($length) == Ok('_') and is_word_byte(bytes.get($length + 1) ?? 0) {
		$length = $length + 2
		while $length < bytes.len() and is_word_byte(bytes.get($length) ?? 0) {
			$length = $length + 1
		}
	}
	if bytes.get($length) == Ok('!') {
		$length = $length + 1
	}
	after = bytes.drop_first($length)
	is_call = after.len() >= 2 and after.first() == Ok('(') and after.last() == Ok(')')
	if after.is_empty() or is_call {
		Ok(Str.from_utf8_lossy(bytes.take_first($length)))
	} else {
		Err(NoName)
	}
}

is_letter_or_digit : U8 -> Bool
is_letter_or_digit = |byte| Text.is_capital(byte) or Text.is_small_letter(byte) or Text.is_digit(byte)

## A text without the `#`s that start it.
without_hashes : Str -> Str
without_hashes = |text| {
	bytes = text.to_utf8()
	start = bytes.find_first_index(|byte| byte != '#') ?? bytes.len()
	Str.from_utf8_lossy(bytes.drop_first(start))
}

## Whether a text, a space after it, ends in a possessive: `'s` or `s'`,
## with `own` after it or not (`Pipeline's`, `the rules' own`).
is_possessive : Str -> Bool
is_possessive = |text| ["'s ", "s' ", "'s own ", "s' own "].any(|ending| text.ends_with(ending))

is_space : U8 -> Bool
is_space = |byte| byte == ' ' or byte == '\t' or byte == '\n' or byte == '\r' or byte == 12 or byte == 11

## The places of a text's sentence ends: a `.`, `?` or `!` with a space or
## the text's end after it.
sentence_ends : Str -> List(U64)
sentence_ends = |text| {
	bytes = text.to_utf8()
	var $ends = []
	$at : U64
	var $at = 0
	for byte in bytes {
		is_mark = byte == '.' or byte == '?' or byte == '!'
		is_last = $at + 1 == bytes.len()
		if is_mark and (is_last or is_space(bytes.get($at + 1) ?? 0)) {
			$ends = $ends.append($at)
		}
		$at = $at + 1
	}
	$ends
}

## The text of the sentence before byte `at` of comment line `number`:
## back across the comment lines above, their `#`s gone, until a `.`, `?`
## or `!` that ends a sentence, a blank comment line, or the comment's
## start.
sentence_before : List(Str), U64, U64 -> Str
sentence_before = |source_lines, number, at| {
	on_line = Text.bytes_of(Text.trim(Text.line_at(source_lines, number)), { start: 0, count: at })
	var $text = Text.trim(without_hashes(on_line))
	var $up = number - 1
	var $is_blank_above = Bool.False
	while !($is_blank_above) and sentence_ends($text).is_empty() and $up >= 1 and Text.trim(Text.line_at(source_lines, $up)).starts_with("#") {
		above = Text.trim(without_hashes(Text.trim(Text.line_at(source_lines, $up))))
		if above == "" {
			$is_blank_above = Bool.True
		} else {
			$text = "${above} ${$text}"
			$up = $up - 1
		}
	}
	match sentence_ends($text).last() {
		Ok(last) => Text.bytes_of($text, { start: last + 1, count: $text.count_utf8_bytes() })
		Err(_) => $text
	}
}

## Whether a sentence names a source a citation names, as a whole word or a
## possessive (`Rust`, `Rust's`, `Zig,`).
cites_source : Str, Set(Str) -> Bool
cites_source = |sentence, sources|
	Text.words(sentence).any(
		|word| {
			unpossessed = if word.ends_with("'s") {
				word.drop_suffix("'s")
			} else if word.ends_with("s'") {
				word.drop_suffix("s'")
			} else {
				word
			}
			bare = Str.from_utf8_lossy(unpossessed.to_utf8().drop_if(|byte| byte == ',' or byte == ';' or byte == ':' or byte == '(' or byte == ')' or byte == '"'))
			sources.contains(bare)
		},
	)

cookbook/roc/hunt_names/Facts.roc, 222 lines

## The facts the reading of the files gathers for the checks judged over the
## whole tree: each file's declared
## keywords, the tag unions types name, the aliases of `Bool`, the kinds of
## types a file declares, each type name a file declares, and the type and
## field names `container` reads.
import lib.Text
import lib.Tree
import ShortNames
import TypeText

Facts := [].{

	## A type's or a record field's name, for `container`: its words, the
	## doc above its declaration, lowercased; a field's also whether it is a
	## letter of a set beside its siblings, what it gives and its first
	## argument's type when it is a function.
	Named : {
		path : Str,
		line : U64,
		name : Str,
		words : List(Str),
		is_field : Bool,
		doc : Str,
		is_letter_of_set : Bool,
		gives : Str,
		is_function : Bool,
		first : Str,
	}

	## What the reading gathers: each file's `# keywords:` words, by path;
	## each type's tag union, by the type's name; the names of aliases of
	## `Bool`, bare and as `Owner.Name`; each type a file declares, by path,
	## as whether it is `[].{ ... }`; each type name as `path|Name`; and the
	## type and field names.
	Gathered : {
		keywords : Dict(Str, List(Str)),
		unions : Dict(Str, TypeText.Union),
		bool_aliases : Set(Str),
		type_kinds : Dict(Str, List(Bool)),
		type_names : Set(Str),
		names : List(Facts.Named),
	}

	## A parsed file: its path, its tree and its text cut at each newline.
	FileRead : { path : Str, nodes : List(Tree.Node), source_lines : List(Str) }

	## No facts yet, to add files to.
	none : Facts.Gathered
	none = {
		keywords: Dict.empty(),
		unions: Dict.empty(),
		bool_aliases: Set.empty(),
		type_kinds: Dict.empty(),
		type_names: Set.empty(),
		names: [],
	}

	## The facts of `earlier` files, then those of a `later` one: where both
	## name a type's union, the later's stands.
	joined : Facts.Gathered, Facts.Gathered -> Facts.Gathered
	joined = |earlier, later| {
		keywords: later.keywords.to_list().fold(earlier.keywords, |into, (path, words)| into.insert(path, (into.get(path) ?? []).concat(words))),
		unions: later.unions.to_list().fold(earlier.unions, |into, (name, union)| into.insert(name, union)),
		bool_aliases: earlier.bool_aliases.union(later.bool_aliases),
		type_kinds: later.type_kinds.to_list().fold(earlier.type_kinds, |into, (path, kinds)| into.insert(path, (into.get(path) ?? []).concat(kinds))),
		type_names: earlier.type_names.union(later.type_names),
		names: earlier.names.concat(later.names),
	}

	## A file's first facts: the keywords it declares in a comment line
	## `# keywords: for, on`, lowercased.
	keywords_of : Facts.FileRead -> Facts.Gathered
	keywords_of = |file| {
		var $words = []
		for source_line in file.source_lines {
			trimmed = Text.trim(source_line)
			if trimmed.starts_with("# keywords: ") {
				for word in trimmed.drop_prefix("# keywords: ").split_on(",") {
					if Text.trim(word) != "" {
						$words = $words.append(Text.lower(Text.trim(word)))
					}
				}
			}
		}
		keywords = if $words.is_empty() {
			Dict.empty()
		} else {
			Dict.empty().insert(file.path, $words)
		}
		{ ..Facts.none, keywords }
	}

	## The facts with what the type declaration at `at` declares: its tag
	## union, its kind, its name, and its name as an alias of `Bool` when it
	## is one.
	with_type_declaration : Facts.FileRead, U64, Facts.Gathered -> Facts.Gathered
	with_type_declaration = |file, at, facts| {
		nodes = file.nodes
		node = Tree.node_at(nodes, at)
		declared = match node.kids.first() {
			Ok(name_at) => Tree.attribute(Tree.node_at(nodes, name_at), "name")
			Err(_) => ""
		}
		if declared == "" {
			return facts
		}
		built_on = match node.kids.get(1) {
			Ok(built_at) => Ok(Tree.node_at(nodes, built_at))
			Err(_) => Err(NotBuilt)
		}
		is_union = match built_on {
			Ok(built) => built.kind == "ty-tag-union"
			Err(_) => Bool.False
		}
		unions = if is_union {
			facts.unions.insert(declared, TypeText.union_shape(nodes, Tree.kid_at(node, 2)))
		} else {
			facts.unions
		}
		has_no_tags = (unions.get(declared) ?? { names: [], has_payload: Bool.False }).names.is_empty()
		is_holder = is_union and has_no_tags and Tree.node_at(nodes, Tree.last_kid(node)).kind == "associated"
		named = {
			path: file.path,
			line: node.line,
			name: declared,
			words: Text.name_words(declared),
			is_field: Bool.False,
			doc: doc_above(file.source_lines, node.line),
			is_letter_of_set: Bool.False,
			gives: "",
			is_function: Bool.False,
			first: "",
		}
		is_bool_alias = match built_on {
			Ok(built) => built.kind == "ty" and Tree.attribute(built, "name") == "Bool"
			Err(_) => Bool.False
		}
		{
			..facts,
			unions,
			type_kinds: facts.type_kinds.insert(file.path, (facts.type_kinds.get(file.path) ?? []).append(is_holder)),
			type_names: facts.type_names.insert("${file.path}|${declared}"),
			names: facts.names.append(named),
			bool_aliases: if is_bool_alias {
				facts.bool_aliases.union(Set.from_list(bool_alias_names(nodes, node, declared)))
			} else {
				facts.bool_aliases
			},
		}
	}

	## The facts with the record field at `at`, declared at line
	## `declaration_line`, as a name `container` and `singular_list` read.
	with_field : Facts.FileRead, U64, U64, Facts.Gathered -> Facts.Gathered
	with_field = |file, at, declaration_line, facts| {
		nodes = file.nodes
		node = Tree.node_at(nodes, at)
		field = Tree.attribute(node, "name")
		siblings = Set.from_list(Tree.node_at(nodes, node.parent).kids.map(|kid| Tree.attribute(Tree.node_at(nodes, kid), "name")))
		field_type_at = Tree.first_kid(node)
		field_type = Tree.node_at(nodes, field_type_at)
		is_function = field_type.kind == "ty-fn"
		gives = if is_function {
			Tree.written_type(nodes, Tree.last_kid(field_type))
		} else {
			Tree.written_type(nodes, field_type_at)
		}
		first = if is_function and field_type.kids.len() > 1 {
			Tree.written_type(nodes, Tree.first_kid(field_type))
		} else {
			""
		}
		named = {
			path: file.path,
			line: node.line,
			name: field,
			words: Text.name_words(field),
			is_field: Bool.True,
			doc: doc_above(file.source_lines, declaration_line),
			is_letter_of_set: ShortNames.is_letter_of_set(field, siblings),
			gives,
			is_function,
			first,
		}
		{ ..facts, names: facts.names.append(named) }
	}
}

## An alias of `Bool`'s names: bare, and for a module type's member
## `Owner.Name`, as the checker writes it.
bool_alias_names : List(Tree.Node), Tree.Node, Str -> List(Str)
bool_alias_names = |nodes, node, declared| {
	if node.parent == 0 {
		return [declared]
	}
	parent = Tree.node_at(nodes, node.parent)
	if parent.kind != "associated" or parent.parent == 0 {
		return [declared]
	}
	owner = match Tree.node_at(nodes, parent.parent).kids.first() {
		Ok(owner_at) => Tree.attribute(Tree.node_at(nodes, owner_at), "name")
		Err(_) => ""
	}
	if owner == "" {
		[declared]
	} else {
		[declared, "${owner}.${declared}"]
	}
}

## The comment lines directly above line `line`, nearest first, trimmed,
## lowercased and joined: a declaration's doc.
doc_above : List(Str), U64 -> Str
doc_above = |source_lines, line| {
	var $parts = []
	var $above = line
	while $above > 1 and Text.trim(Text.line_at(source_lines, $above - 1)).starts_with("#") {
		$parts = $parts.append(Text.lower(Text.trim(Text.line_at(source_lines, $above - 1))))
		$above = $above - 1
	}
	Str.join_with($parts, " ")
}

cookbook/roc/hunt_names/Judge.roc, 346 lines

## hunt_names' checks of one definition (the Shale original's
## `judge_definition`): every check but `container`, `preposition_split`,
## `where_name`, `stale_doc_name` and the bindings' `short_name`, which are
## judged over the files afterwards. The launcher's header says what each
## finds. Also the act an effect's name starts with, which the census
## counts and `noun_effect` and `state_effect` judge.
import lib.Finding
import Facts
import ListNames
import Makers
import Reading
import TypeText
import Words

Judge := [].{

	## The word an effect's name acts by: its first, or the one after a
	## namespace prefix; what that word says (`participle`, `verb`, `vague`,
	## `asks` or `refused`); and how a finding names its place.
	Act : { word : Str, verdict : Str, place : Str }

	## What a name's first word says: `participle`, `verb`, `vague`, `asks`
	## (`is`, `has`) or `refused`.
	first_word_verdict : Str, Words.Lists -> Str
	first_word_verdict = |word, lists|
		if Words.reads_as_participle(word, lists.participles, lists.ed_verbs) {
			"participle"
		} else if lists.verbs.contains(word) {
			"verb"
		} else if lists.vague.contains(word) {
			"vague"
		} else if word == "is" or word == "has" {
			"asks"
		} else {
			"refused"
		}

	## Whether the name is an effect, its `!` its own rather than a
	## callback's.
	is_effectful : Reading.Definition -> Bool
	is_effectful = |definition| definition.name.ends_with("!") and !(definition.has_callback)

	## The act of a name's words, `is_effect` saying whether it is an
	## effect's: a namespace prefix counts only before an effect's act.
	act_of : List(Str), Bool, Words.Lists -> Judge.Act
	act_of = |words, is_effect, lists| {
		first = word_at(words, 1)
		namespace = if is_effect and words.len() > 1 {
			lists.namespaces.get(first)
		} else {
			Err(KeyNotFound)
		}
		match namespace {
			Ok(instructions) => {
				word = word_at(words, 2)
				said = Judge.first_word_verdict(word, lists)
				verdict = if said == "refused" and instructions.contains(word) {
					"verb"
				} else {
					said
				}
				{ word, verdict, place: "the word after its namespace `${first}_`" }
			}
			Err(_) => { word: first, verdict: Judge.first_word_verdict(first, lists), place: "its first word" }
		}
	}

	## What each check judged here finds in one definition, in the Shale
	## original's order. `facts` are every file's.
	findings : Reading.Definition, Words.Lists, Facts.Gathered -> List(Finding)
	findings = |definition, lists, facts| {
		full_name = definition.name
		if lists.fixed_names.contains(full_name) {
			return []
		}
		has_bang = full_name.ends_with("!")
		name = full_name.drop_suffix("!")
		is_effect = Judge.is_effectful(definition)
		words = name.split_on("_")
		first = word_at(words, 1)
		judged_here = !(definition.is_paired)
		is_participle = |word| Words.reads_as_participle(word, lists.participles, lists.ed_verbs)
		act = Judge.act_of(words, is_effect, lists)
		named_as_state = is_participle(act.word) and !(name.contains("_is_") or name.contains("_has_"))
		var $found = []
		report = |check, what| { path: definition.path, line: definition.line, check, what }
		draws_on_surface = match definition.arguments.first() {
			Ok(argument) =>
				match argument.shape {
					Named(named) => named == "Frame" or named == "Canvas"
					_ => Bool.False
				}
			Err(_) => Bool.False
		}
		if is_effect and judged_here and act.verdict == "refused" and !(draws_on_surface) {
			what = if lists.prepositions.contains(act.word) {
				"`${full_name}` has an effect but ${act.place} is a preposition, `${act.word}`: an effect is named for its act"
			} else {
				"`${full_name}` has an effect but ${act.place}, `${act.word}`, is no verb: it reads as a value, not an act"
			}
			$found = $found.append(report("noun_effect", what))
		}
		names_drawn_type = words.len() > 1 and definition.mentioned_types.contains(TypeText.camel_case(words))
		if is_effect and judged_here and named_as_state and !(names_drawn_type) {
			$found = $found.append(report("state_effect", "`${full_name}` has an effect but is named as a state, `${act.word}`: a verb says what it does"))
		}
		named_as_question = words.len() > 1 and ["is", "has", "can", "should"].contains(first)
		signature = signature_of(definition, facts)
		returns_bool = signature.is_function and signature.result == "Bool"
		if named_as_question and judged_here and is_effect and !(returns_bool) {
			gives = if signature.is_function {
				" and gives `${signature.result}`${signature.source_note}"
			} else {
				""
			}
			$found = $found.append(report("question", "`${full_name}` asks a question but has an effect${gives}"))
		}
		if returns_bool and named_as_state and judged_here {
			$found = $found.append(report("question", "`${full_name}` gives a `Bool`${signature.source_note} but is named as a state, `${first}`: ask it (`is_*`, `has_*`)"))
		}
		if named_as_question and judged_here and signature.is_known and signature.is_function and !(is_effect) and signature.result != "Bool" and signature.result != "_" {
			$found = $found.append(report("question", "`${full_name}` asks a question but gives `${signature.result}`${signature.source_note}"))
		}
		if judged_here {
			here = { definition, words, signature, has_bang, returns_bool }
			$found = $found.concat(judged_where_defined(here, lists, facts))
		}
		$found.concat(judged_anywhere(definition, words, lists, facts))
	}
}

## The word at place `at` of `words`, counted from 1.
word_at : List(Str), U64 -> Str
word_at = |words, at|
	if at == 0 {
		""
	} else {
		words.get(at - 1) ?? ""
	}

## What a definition's type says. The type is the checker's when it gave
## one, else the annotation's; it is unknown for a definition with neither.
signature_of : Reading.Definition, Facts.Gathered -> Makers.Signature
signature_of = |definition, facts|
	match definition.typed {
		Typed(written) => {
			parts = TypeText.parts_of(written)
			result = if facts.bool_aliases.contains(parts.result) {
				"Bool"
			} else {
				parts.result
			}
			{ is_function: parts.is_function, first: TypeText.first_argument(parts.arguments), result, is_known: Bool.True, source_note: " (the checker's type)" }
		}
		Untyped => {
			is_function: definition.is_annotation and definition.is_function_type,
			first: definition.first,
			result: definition.result,
			is_known: definition.is_annotation,
			source_note: "",
		}
	}

## A definition judged where it is defined, not at an annotation paired
## with it: its words, what its type says, whether it ends in `!` and gives
## a `Bool`.
Here : {
	definition : Reading.Definition,
	words : List(Str),
	signature : Makers.Signature,
	has_bang : Bool,
	returns_bool : Bool,
}

## The checks judged only where a definition is judged, not at the
## definition an annotation is paired with.
judged_where_defined : Here, Words.Lists, Facts.Gathered -> List(Finding)
judged_where_defined = |here, lists, facts| {
	definition = here.definition
	signature = here.signature
	words = here.words
	full_name = definition.name
	name = full_name.drop_suffix("!")
	first = word_at(words, 1)
	last_word = word_at(words, words.len())
	report = |check, what| { path: definition.path, line: definition.line, check, what }
	var $found = []
	is_entry_point = words.len() == 1 and ["handle", "run", "main"].contains(first)
	if words.all(|word| lists.vague.contains(word)) and !(is_entry_point) {
		$found = $found.append(report("vague", "`${full_name}` is only vague words: what does it handle, and how?"))
	}
	if name.count_utf8_bytes() == 1 {
		$found = $found.append(report("short_name", "`${full_name}` is one letter, read far from where it is defined: name what it holds"))
	}
	leading = if words.len() > 2 {
		words.take_first(words.len() - 2)
	} else {
		[]
	}
	has_leading_noun = leading.any(|word| !(lists.prepositions.contains(word)))
	before_last = word_at(words, words.len() - 1)
	if has_leading_noun and lists.prepositions.contains(last_word) and lists.prepositions.contains(before_last) {
		$found = $found.append(report("stacked_preposition", "`${full_name}` stacks two prepositions, `_${before_last}_${last_word}`: let each read once, the entry named for what it gives (`rest`, `tail_after`) and the worker for what it adds (`rest_onto`)"))
	}
	# A function is known by its type, else by a lambda definition; a value
	# by a type that is no function, else by a definition that is no lambda.
	# An inferred annotation (`two : _`) with no checker's type is neither.
	is_typed = match definition.typed {
		Typed(_) => Bool.True
		Untyped => Bool.False
	}
	has_type = signature.is_known and !(definition.is_annotation and definition.whole == "_" and !(is_typed))
	is_function = signature.is_function or (!(signature.is_known) and definition.is_lambda)
	is_value = (has_type and !(signature.is_function)) or (!(signature.is_known) and !(definition.is_lambda))
	taken_kind = lists.taken.get(name) ?? ""
	capitalized = TypeText.camel_case([name])
	if taken_kind == "roc" and is_function {
		gives_the_word = signature.is_function and (signature.result.split_on(".").last() ?? "") == capitalized
		if !(gives_the_word) {
			$found = $found.append(report("taken_word", "`${full_name}` is Roc's own word, `${name}`, for a function that gives no `${capitalized}`: name it for the domain's thing (`element`, `append`), and keep Roc's words for Roc"))
		}
	}
	if taken_kind == "cardinal" and is_value {
		$found = $found.append(report("taken_word", "`${full_name}` is a number's name for a value: it says how many, not what it holds"))
	}
	is_participle = Words.reads_as_participle(name, lists.participles, lists.ed_verbs)
	if !(here.has_bang) and words.len() == 1 and is_participle and is_function and !(here.returns_bool) {
		$found = $found.append(report("bare_participle", "`${full_name}` is a function named by a bare past participle, which reads as a `Bool`: name it by a noun for what it gives (`user_by_name`) or a verb for what it does (`add_user`)"))
	}
	is_phrase = !(here.has_bang) and lists.prepositions.contains(first) and is_function and !(here.returns_bool) and signature.result != "_"
	if is_phrase and !(Makers.reads_as_maker(definition, words, signature, facts, lists.prepositions)) {
		gives = if signature.is_known {
			"gives `${signature.result}`${signature.source_note}"
		} else {
			"has no annotation to show it makes its own type"
		}
		$found = $found.append(report("phrase_name", "`${full_name}` starts with a preposition, `${first}`, and ${gives}: bare, it reads as a yes or no and hides what it gives; name the thing (`trees_in_view`, not `in_view`)"))
	} else if signature.is_known {
		kind = if signature.is_function {
			"function"
		} else {
			"value"
		}
		subject = { path: definition.path, line: definition.line, name: full_name, kind, is_function: signature.is_function, first: signature.first, gives: signature.result }
		$found = $found.concat(ListNames.findings(subject, lists))
	}
	if !(here.has_bang) and is_function and lists.world_verbs.contains(first) and !(definition.has_doc) {
		$found = $found.append(report("world_verb", "`${full_name}` is pure, and `${first}` claims to act on something outside: name it for the value it gives (`tree_shapes`, not `draw_tree`)"))
	}
	$place : U64
	var $place = 0
	for parameter in definition.parameters {
		$place = $place + 1
		parameter_type = definition.argument_types.get($place - 1) ?? parameter.typed
		if parameter.name != "" {
			subject = { path: definition.path, line: parameter.line, name: parameter.name, kind: "parameter", is_function: Bool.False, first: "", gives: parameter_type }
			$found = $found.concat(ListNames.findings(subject, lists))
		}
	}
	$found
}

## The checks judged at an annotation and at its definition alike.
judged_anywhere : Reading.Definition, List(Str), Words.Lists, Facts.Gathered -> List(Finding)
judged_anywhere = |definition, words, lists, facts| {
	full_name = definition.name
	first = word_at(words, 1)
	last_word = word_at(words, words.len())
	report = |check, what| { path: definition.path, line: definition.line, check, what }
	var $found = []
	# `worker_name` is judged at the definition, which knows whether it calls
	# itself, and at an annotation only when no definition follows it, as
	# with a hosted effect.
	is_annotation_alone = definition.is_annotation and !(definition.has_definition)
	is_helper_suffix = helper_suffixes.contains(last_word) and (is_annotation_alone or !(definition.is_annotation))
	is_recursion_suffix = Reading.recursion_suffixes.contains(last_word) and definition.recurses
	if words.len() > 1 and (is_helper_suffix or is_recursion_suffix) {
		$found = $found.append(report("worker_name", "`${full_name}` is named only as a helper, `_${last_word}`: name the worker for the parameter it adds (`_from` a start point, `_onto` an output built, `_with` other carried state) and give the entry function the plain name"))
	}
	if definition.is_annotation and !(definition.is_function_type) and definition.whole != "_" {
		annotated = definition.whole
		if last_word == "count" and !(integer_types.contains(annotated)) {
			$found = $found.append(report("name_type", "`${full_name}` is a count of type `${annotated}`"))
		}
		if last_word == "path" and annotated != "Str" and !(annotated.contains("Path")) {
			$found = $found.append(report("name_type", "`${full_name}` is a path of type `${annotated}`"))
		}
		if annotated == "Bool" and (first == "no" or first == "not") and words.len() > 1 {
			$found = $found.append(report("negative", "`${full_name}` is a negative flag: `${full_name} = Bool.false` reads twice"))
		}
	}
	if definition.is_annotation and Judge.is_effectful(definition) and definition.is_function_type {
		for argument in definition.arguments {
			$found = $found.concat(tense_findings(definition, argument, lists, facts))
		}
	}
	if definition.is_annotation and words.len() > 2 and first == "is" and word_at(words, 2) == "not" {
		$found = $found.append(report("negative", "`${full_name}` asks a negative: `!${full_name}(...)` reads twice"))
	}
	$found
}

## What `command_tense` and `mixed_tense` find in one argument an effect's
## annotation takes: a tag union written in place, or one a type declared
## in any file checked names.
tense_findings : Reading.Definition, TypeText.ArgumentShape, Words.Lists, Facts.Gathered -> List(Finding)
tense_findings = |definition, argument, lists, facts| {
	union = match argument.shape {
		Written(written) => written
		Named(named) =>
			match facts.unions.get(named) {
				Ok(declared) => declared
				Err(_) => return []
			}
		Unread => return []
	}
	report = |check, what| { path: definition.path, line: definition.line, check, what }
	listed = if argument.is_list {
		"a list of "
	} else {
		""
	}
	shown = "${listed}`[${Str.join_with(union.names, ", ")}]`"
	is_participle = |word| Words.reads_as_participle(word, lists.participles, lists.ed_verbs)
	var $found = []
	all_past = union.names.all(|tag| is_participle(TypeText.tag_first_word(tag)))
	if !(union.has_payload) and union.names.len() >= 2 and all_past {
		$found = $found.append(report("command_tense", "`${definition.name}` takes ${shown}, an instruction named like an event: name its tags as commands (`Pinned` is `Pin`)"))
	}
	event_tags = union.names.keep_if(|tag| is_participle(TypeText.tag_first_word(tag)))
	command_tags = union.names.keep_if(|tag| !(is_participle(TypeText.tag_first_word(tag))) and lists.verbs.contains(TypeText.tag_first_word(tag)))
	if !(command_tags.is_empty()) and !(event_tags.is_empty()) {
		commands = Str.join_with(command_tags, ", ")
		events = Str.join_with(event_tags, ", ")
		$found = $found.append(report("mixed_tense", "`${definition.name}` takes ${shown}: commands (${commands}) beside events (${events}): name what it is told to do in one mood"))
	}
	$found
}

## The suffixes `worker_name` reports always: they say only that a
## function is a helper.
helper_suffixes : List(Str)
helper_suffixes = ["acc", "loop", "inner", "helper", "rec"]

integer_types : List(Str)
integer_types = ["U8", "U16", "U32", "U64", "U128", "I8", "I16", "I32", "I64", "I128"]

cookbook/roc/hunt_names/ListNames.roc, 217 lines

## What hunt_names' `singular_list` reads of a name whose type says many:
## the word that counts,
## whether it reads as a plural, and the names a finding offers instead. A
## list that is no function and is named from a preposition is
## `phrase_name`'s instead, as the launcher's header says.
import lib.Finding
import lib.Text
import lib.Tree
import TypeText
import Words

ListNames := [].{

	## A name whose type may say many: the file and line it is at, the name,
	## what the finding calls it (`function`, `value`, `parameter`, `field`),
	## whether it is a function, its first argument's type and what it gives
	## or holds.
	Subject : {
		path : Str,
		line : U64,
		name : Str,
		kind : Str,
		is_function : Bool,
		first : Str,
		gives : Str,
	}

	## The finding a name whose type says many and whose head word says one
	## makes, if it makes one.
	findings : ListNames.Subject, Words.Lists -> List(Finding)
	findings = |subject, lists| {
		element = match TypeText.list_element(subject.gives) {
			Ok(found) => found
			Err(NoList) => return []
		}
		bare = subject.name.drop_suffix("!")
		kind_of = |word| lists.list_names.get(word) ?? ""
		if element == "U8" or bare.count_utf8_bytes() < 2 or (lists.taken.get(bare) ?? "") == "cardinal" or kind_of(bare) == "accumulator" {
			return []
		}
		words = joined_terms(bare.split_on("_"), lists.terms)
		says = if subject.is_function {
			"gives"
		} else {
			"holds"
		}
		opening = "the ${subject.kind} `${subject.name}` ${says} `${subject.gives}`"
		at = head_word_at(words, lists)
		head = word_at(words, at)
		first_word = word_at(words, 1)
		if head == "list" or reads_as_plural(head, lists) {
			return []
		}
		term_element = lists.terms.lists.get(head)
		match term_element {
			Ok(named) if named != "" and Tree.last_part(TypeText.type_head(element)) == named => return []
			Ok(named) if named == "" and subject.is_function and words.len() == 1 => return []
			_ => {}
		}
		starts_with_act = subject.is_function and lists.verbs.contains(first_word) and kind_of(first_word) != "one"
		is_changed_copy = subject.is_function and subject.first == subject.gives
		if is_changed_copy and words.len() > 1 {
			return []
		}
		if TypeText.element_word(element) != head {
			if kind_of(head) == "many" or Words.reads_as_participle(head, lists.participles, lists.ed_verbs) {
				return []
			}
			if is_changed_copy or (starts_with_act and words.len() == 1) {
				return []
			}
		}
		said = |check, what| [{ path: subject.path, line: subject.line, check, what }]
		if lists.prepositions.contains(first_word) and !(subject.is_function) {
			said("phrase_name", "${opening} and starts with a preposition, `${first_word}`: bare, it hides what it holds; name the thing (`trees_in_view`, not `in_view`)")
		} else if kind_of(head) == "adjective" {
			held = held_plural(element)
			example = if held != "" {
				" (`${head}_${held}`)"
			} else {
				""
			}
			said("singular_list", "${opening} but the word that counts, `${head}`, is an adjective: the name has no noun; say what the list holds${example}")
		} else {
			said("singular_list", "${opening} but reads as one thing, `${head}`: ${honest_list_names(bare, words, at, element)}")
		}
	}
}

## The word at place `at` of `words`, counted from 1.
word_at : List(Str), U64 -> Str
word_at = |words, at| words.get(at - 1) ?? ""

## `words` with each run of words that spells a term joined into one word,
## the longest term first: `two`, `opt`, `stops` gives `two_opt`, `stops`.
joined_terms : List(Str), Words.Terms -> List(Str)
joined_terms = |words, terms| {
	term_words = terms.words.to_list().map(|(_, spelled)| spelled)
	var $joined = []
	$at : U64
	var $at = 0
	while $at < words.len() {
		rest = words.drop_first($at)
		taken = term_words.fold(
			1,
			|longest, spelled| if spelled.len() > longest and rest.take_first(spelled.len()) == spelled {
				spelled.len()
			} else {
				longest
			},
		)
		$joined = $joined.append(Str.join_with(rest.take_first(taken), "_"))
		$at = $at + taken
	}
	$joined
}

## The place of the word of a name that says what it is, counted from 1:
## the one before the first preposition or word list_names.txt calls
## `after`, past the name's first word (`trees_in_view` gives `trees`), else
## the last that is not digits alone (`corner_2` gives `corner`).
head_word_at : List(Str), Words.Lists -> U64
head_word_at = |words, lists| {
	$place : U64
	var $place = 2
	while $place <= words.len() {
		word = word_at(words, $place)
		if lists.prepositions.contains(word) or lists.list_names.get(word) == Ok("after") {
			return $place - 1
		}
		$place = $place + 1
	}
	var $at = words.len()
	while $at > 1 and is_digits(word_at(words, $at)) {
		$at = $at - 1
	}
	$at
}

is_digits : Str -> Bool
is_digits = |word| {
	bytes = word.to_utf8()
	!(bytes.is_empty()) and bytes.all(Text.is_digit)
}

## Whether a word reads as a plural. An `s` doesn't make one in `class`, in a
## word list_names.txt calls `one` (`axis`), or after letters that are no
## word (`pts`); after one letter it does (`xs`).
reads_as_plural : Str, Words.Lists -> Bool
reads_as_plural = |word, lists| {
	if lists.list_names.get(word) == Ok("one") or !(word.ends_with("s")) or word.ends_with("ss") {
		return Bool.False
	}
	stem = word.drop_suffix("s").to_utf8()
	stem.len() == 1 or stem.any(|byte| byte == 'a' or byte == 'e' or byte == 'i' or byte == 'o' or byte == 'u' or byte == 'y')
}

## A word's plural, as English spells most.
plural_of : Str -> Str
plural_of = |word| {
	is_vowel_before_last = match word.to_utf8() {
		[.., before, _] => before == 'a' or before == 'e' or before == 'i' or before == 'o' or before == 'u'
		_ => Bool.False
	}
	if word.ends_with("y") and !(is_vowel_before_last) {
		"${word.drop_suffix("y")}ies"
	} else if ["s", "x", "z", "ch", "sh"].any(|ending| word.ends_with(ending)) {
		"${word}es"
	} else {
		"${word}s"
	}
}

## The plural of what a list of `element` holds, for a name to say it, or
## `""` when the element has no word of its own: a type variable, a
## number, text.
held_plural : Str -> Str
held_plural = |element| {
	held = TypeText.element_word(element)
	starts_capital = match element.to_utf8().first() {
		Ok(byte) => Text.is_capital(byte)
		Err(_) => Bool.False
	}
	if held == "" or !(starts_capital) or plain_elements.contains(element) {
		""
	} else {
		plural_of(held)
	}
}

## The element types that hold no word of their own.
plain_elements : List(Str)
plain_elements = ["U16", "U32", "U64", "I16", "I32", "I64", "F32", "F64", "Dec", "Str", "Bool"]

## The names `singular_list` offers for `bare`, whose head word is at `at`
## in `words`: the plural of what the list holds put after the head, as in
## `herd_cows`, or the head's own plural when the element is that word, a
## number or text; else the name with `_list`.
honest_list_names : Str, List(Str), U64, Str -> Str
honest_list_names = |bare, words, at, element| {
	held = held_plural(element)
	says_what_it_holds = held != "" and TypeText.element_word(element) != word_at(words, at)
	var $plural_words = []
	$place : U64
	var $place = 0
	for word in words {
		$place = $place + 1
		if $place != at {
			$plural_words = $plural_words.append(word)
		} else if says_what_it_holds {
			$plural_words = $plural_words.append(word).append(held)
		} else {
			$plural_words = $plural_words.append(plural_of(word))
		}
	}
	"`${Str.join_with($plural_words, "_")}`, or `${bare}_list`"
}

cookbook/roc/hunt_names/Passes.roc, 237 lines

## hunt_names' checks judged over what the whole read gathered, once every
## file is read (the Shale original's naming_passes.shale):
## `preposition_split`, from
## the trailing prepositions each file puts on its stems; `container` and a
## field's `short_name`, from the type and field names; `where_name`, from a
## file's `where` clauses; and the census of effects' first words that
## `words=1` prints. The launcher's header says what each check finds.
import lib.Finding
import lib.Text
import lib.Tree
import Facts
import Judge
import Reading
import Words

Passes := [].{

	## An effect's first word in the census: how many effects start with it
	## and what it says.
	Counted : { count : U64, verdict : Str }

	## What `preposition_split` finds in the definitions, in the order of
	## their files' paths and stems. `keywords` are each file's declared
	## keywords, by path.
	preposition_splits : List(Reading.Definition), Words.Lists, Dict(Str, List(Str)) -> List(Finding)
	preposition_splits = |definitions, lists, keywords| {
		var $groups = Dict.empty()
		var $shapes = Dict.empty()
		var $conventions = Set.empty()
		for definition in definitions {
			words = definition.name.drop_suffix("!").split_on("_")
			preposition = words.last() ?? ""
			is_judged = !(lists.fixed_names.contains(definition.name)) and !(definition.is_paired)
			if is_judged and words.len() > 1 and lists.prepositions.contains(preposition) {
				stem = Str.join_with(words.drop_last(1), "_")
				key = "${definition.path}|${stem}"
				group = $groups.get(key) ?? { path: definition.path, line: definition.line, stem, uses: Dict.empty() }
				if definition.is_annotation and definition.is_function_type {
					shape_key = "${definition.path}|${preposition}|${definition.first}|${definition.result}"
					stems = ($shapes.get(shape_key) ?? Set.empty()).insert(stem)
					$shapes = $shapes.insert(shape_key, stems)
					if stems.len() >= convention_stems {
						$conventions = $conventions.insert("${definition.path}|${preposition}")
					}
				}
				uses = if group.uses.contains(preposition) {
					group.uses
				} else {
					group.uses.insert(preposition, { name: definition.name, arity: definition.arity })
				}
				$groups = $groups.insert(key, { ..group, uses })
			}
		}
		Text.sort_bytewise($groups.keys()).map(
			|key| match $groups.get(key) {
				Ok(group) => split_findings(group, $conventions, keywords)
				Err(_) => []
			},
		).join()
	}

	## What `short_name` and `container` find in one type or field name.
	container_findings : Facts.Named, Words.Lists -> List(Finding)
	container_findings = |named, lists| {
		report = |check, what| { path: named.path, line: named.line, check, what }
		is_container_word = |word| lists.vague.contains(word) or lists.containers.contains(word)
		is_only_containers = !(named.words.is_empty()) and named.words.all(is_container_word)
		is_owned = named.words.any(|word| doc_says_whose(named.doc, word))
		# A field of a plain value (`entry : F64`) holds nothing a container
		# could.
		is_scalar = named.is_field and !(named.is_function) and scalar_types.contains(named.gives)
		var $found = []
		if named.is_field and named.name.count_utf8_bytes() == 1 and !(named.is_letter_of_set) {
			$found = $found.append(report("short_name", "the field `${named.name}` is one letter, read far from where it is set: name what it holds"))
		}
		if is_only_containers and !(is_owned) and !(is_scalar) {
			what = if named.is_field {
				"the field `"
			} else {
				"the type `"
			}
			$found = $found.append(report("container", "${what}${named.name}` is only container words: name it for what it holds, or say whose it is in its doc (`## A folder's entry`)"))
		}
		$found
	}

	## What `where_name` finds in one parsed file. `fixed_names` are the
	## methods Roc calls by name, which pass.
	where_name_findings : Str, List(Tree.Node), Set(Str) -> List(Finding)
	where_name_findings = |path, nodes, fixed_names| {
		is_where_method = |node| node.kind == "method" and node.parent > 0 and Tree.node_at(nodes, node.parent).kind == "where"
		nodes
			.keep_if(is_where_method)
			.keep_if(
				|node| {
					name = Tree.attribute(node, "name")
					name.drop_suffix("!").split_on("_").len() < 2 and !(fixed_names.contains(name))
				},
			)
			.map(
				|node| {
					name = Tree.attribute(node, "name")
					{ path, line: node.line, check: "where_name", what: "the `where` method `${name}` is one word, and a `where` clause matches by name alone: say what it is for (`scenery_height`, not `height`)" }
				},
			)
	}

	## Each first word the definitions' effects start with, counted, with
	## its verdict where the word first appears.
	census : List(Reading.Definition), Words.Lists -> Dict(Str, Passes.Counted)
	census = |definitions, lists| {
		var $counted = Dict.empty()
		for definition in definitions {
			is_effect = Judge.is_effectful(definition)
			if is_effect and !(definition.is_paired) and !(lists.fixed_names.contains(definition.name)) {
				act = Judge.act_of(definition.name.drop_suffix("!").split_on("_"), is_effect, lists)
				before = $counted.get(act.word) ?? { count: 0, verdict: act.verdict }
				$counted = $counted.insert(act.word, { ..before, count: before.count + 1 })
			}
		}
		$counted
	}

	## The census `words=1` prints: a line a word, the most used first, and
	## the summary's counts.
	census_lines : Dict(Str, Passes.Counted) -> { lines : List(Str), summary : Str }
	census_lines = |counted| {
		rows = counted.to_list().sort_with(
			|(word, row), (other_word, other_row)|
				if row.count > other_row.count {
					Before
				} else if row.count < other_row.count {
					After
				} else {
					Text.byte_order(word, other_word)
				},
		)
		row_lines = rows.map(|(word, row)| "${padded_left(row.count.to_str(), 4)} ${padded_right(word, 12)} ${row.verdict}")
		count_of = |counted_rows| counted_rows.map(|(_, row)| row.count).sum()
		total = count_of(rows)
		by_verdict = |verdict| count_of(rows.keep_if(|(_, row)| row.verdict == verdict))
		verdict_counts = ["verb", "participle", "vague", "asks", "refused"].map(|verdict| "${verdict} ${by_verdict(verdict).to_str()}")
		summary = "${total.to_str()} effects, ${rows.len().to_str()} first words; effects by verdict: ${Str.join_with(verdict_counts, ", ")}"
		{ lines: row_lines, summary }
	}
}

## A stem's first use of each trailing preposition, by the preposition.
Group : {
	path : Str,
	line : U64,
	stem : Str,
	uses : Dict(Str, { name : Str, arity : I64 }),
}

## How many stems of one shape make a preposition a file's convention.
convention_stems : U64
convention_stems = 3

## The pairs of opposite prepositions, sorted and joined by `|`.
opposite_pairs : List(Str)
opposite_pairs = ["after|before", "from|to", "with|without", "over|under"]

## A field of one of these holds one plain value, so `container` passes it.
scalar_types : List(Str)
scalar_types = ["U8", "U16", "U32", "U64", "U128", "I8", "I16", "I32", "I64", "I128", "F32", "F64", "Dec", "Str", "Bool"]

## The finding of one stem's group, if its prepositions split it.
split_findings : Group, Set(Str), Dict(Str, List(Str)) -> List(Finding)
split_findings = |group, conventions, keywords| {
	arities = group.uses.to_list().map(|(_, used)| used.arity).keep_if(|arity| arity >= 0)
	fewest = arities.min() ?? -1
	declared = keywords.get(group.path) ?? []
	split = Text.sort_bytewise(group.uses.keys()).keep_if(
		|preposition| {
			arity = (group.uses.get(preposition) ?? { name: "", arity: -1 }).arity
			is_from_worker = preposition == "from" and fewest >= 0 and arity > fewest
			is_convention = conventions.contains("${group.path}|${preposition}")
			!(is_from_worker) and !(is_convention) and !(declared.contains(preposition))
		},
	)
	names = split.map(|preposition| (group.uses.get(preposition) ?? { name: "", arity: -1 }).name)
	is_opposite_pair = split.len() == 2 and opposite_pairs.contains(Str.join_with(split, "|"))
	if split.len() > 1 and !(is_opposite_pair) {
		what = "`${group.stem}` takes ${split.len().to_str()} prepositions here (${Str.join_with(names, ", ")}): one relation keeps one preposition, or the names say how they differ"
		[{ path: group.path, line: group.line, check: "preposition_split", what }]
	} else {
		[]
	}
}

## Whether a doc says whose a container word is (`a folder's entry`, `a
## listing's entries`), in the word's singular or plural.
doc_says_whose : Str, Str -> Bool
doc_says_whose = |doc, word| {
	plain = [word, "${word}s"]
	from_ies = if word.ends_with("ies") {
		["${word.drop_suffix("ies")}y"]
	} else {
		[]
	}
	to_ies = if word.ends_with("y") {
		["${word.drop_suffix("y")}ies"]
	} else {
		[]
	}
	from_s = if word.ends_with("s") {
		[word.drop_suffix("s")]
	} else {
		[]
	}
	plain.concat(from_ies).concat(to_ies).concat(from_s).any(|form| doc.contains("'s ${form}"))
}

## The text with spaces before it to `width` bytes, kept whole when longer
## (Shale's `pad(text, -width)`).
padded_left : Str, U64 -> Str
padded_left = |text, width| {
	length = text.count_utf8_bytes()
	if length >= width {
		text
	} else {
		"${Str.repeat(" ", width - length)}${text}"
	}
}

## The text with spaces after it to `width` bytes (Shale's `pad(text,
## width)`).
padded_right : Str, U64 -> Str
padded_right = |text, width| {
	length = text.count_utf8_bytes()
	if length >= width {
		text
	} else {
		"${text}${Str.repeat(" ", width - length)}"
	}
}

cookbook/roc/hunt_names/Reading.roc, 334 lines

## What hunt_names reads of each file: a record for every top-level and module-member
## annotation and definition, leaving out the names the file's header
## dictates, and along the way the facts (Facts) the checks judged over the
## whole tree need.
import lib.Headers
import lib.Text
import lib.Tree
import Facts
import TypeText

Reading := [].{

	## A lambda's argument: its name (`""` for a pattern that is no plain
	## name), its line, and the checker's type of it (`""` for none).
	Parameter : { name : Str, line : U64, typed : Str }

	## A definition, from its annotation or its `name = ...`. An annotation
	## has `whole`, its type, and `result`, what it gives; a function's also
	## `first`, `arity` and `argument_types`, and an effect's the type names it
	## mentions and each argument's shape. A definition whose annotation is
	## just above it is paired, and the annotation then has its definition's
	## checker's type, callback and parameters.
	Definition : {
		path : Str,
		line : U64,
		name : Str,
		owner : Str,
		is_annotation : Bool,
		is_function_type : Bool,
		has_callback : Bool,
		is_paired : Bool,
		has_definition : Bool,
		has_doc : Bool,
		whole : Str,
		result : Str,
		first : Str,
		arity : I64,
		argument_types : List(Str),
		mentioned_types : Set(Str),
		arguments : List(TypeText.ArgumentShape),
		is_lambda : Bool,
		parameters : List(Reading.Parameter),
		recurses : Bool,
		typed : [Typed(Str), Untyped],
	}

	## A parsed file: its path, its tree and its text cut at each newline.
	FileRead : Facts.FileRead

	## The suffixes `worker_name` reports only on a definition that calls
	## itself, as they are ordinary words too.
	recursion_suffixes : List(Str)
	recursion_suffixes = ["step", "walk", "go"]

	## The file's definitions in file order, and the facts it adds.
	## `pattern_types` is the checker's type of each plain-name pattern, by
	## its node's place.
	file_definitions : Reading.FileRead, Dict(U64, Str) -> { definitions : List(Reading.Definition), facts : Facts.Gathered }
	file_definitions = |file, pattern_types| {
		nodes = file.nodes
		dictated = Set.from_list(Headers.header_names(nodes).dictated)
		is_kept = |definition| !(dictated.contains(definition.name) and definition.owner == "")
		var $facts = Facts.keywords_of(file)
		var $outer = []
		var $declaration_lines = []
		var $annotation_places = Dict.empty()
		var $definitions = []
		$at : U64
		var $at = 0
		for node in nodes {
			$at = $at + 1
			at = $at
			kind = node.kind
			is_outer = node.parent == 0 or (($outer.get(node.parent - 1) ?? Bool.False) and outer_kinds.contains(Tree.node_at(nodes, node.parent).kind))
			$outer = $outer.append(is_outer)
			is_declaration = is_outer and (kind == "s-type-anno" or kind == "s-type-decl")
			$declaration_lines = $declaration_lines.append(
				if is_declaration {
					node.line
				} else {
					0
				},
			)
			if is_outer and kind == "s-type-decl" {
				$facts = Facts.with_type_declaration(file, at, $facts)
			}
			if kind == "anno-record-field" {
				declaration_line = field_declaration_line(nodes, $declaration_lines, at)
				if declaration_line != 0 and Tree.attribute(node, "name") != "" {
					$facts = Facts.with_field(file, at, declaration_line, $facts)
				}
			}
			if is_outer and kind == "s-type-anno" {
				match annotation_definition(file, at) {
					Ok(definition) if is_kept(definition) => {
						$annotation_places = $annotation_places.insert(at, $definitions.len())
						$definitions = $definitions.append(definition)
					}
					_ => {}
				}
			}
			if is_outer and kind == "s-decl" {
				match value_definition(file, at, pattern_types) {
					Ok(definition) if is_kept(definition) => {
						above_place = $annotation_places.get(TypeText.previous_sibling(nodes, at))
						match above_place {
							Ok(place) => {
								above = definition_at($definitions, place)
								if above.name == definition.name {
									paired = with_definition(above, definition)
									$definitions = replaced($definitions, place, paired).append({ ..definition, is_paired: Bool.True })
								} else {
									$definitions = $definitions.append(definition)
								}
							}
							Err(_) => {
								$definitions = $definitions.append(definition)
							}
						}
					}
					_ => {}
				}
			}
		}
		{ definitions: $definitions, facts: $facts }
	}
}

## The kinds of node a definition may sit in and still be top-level or a
## module type's member, which `associated` holds.
outer_kinds : List(Str)
outer_kinds = ["file", "statements", "s-type-decl", "associated"]

definition_at : List(Reading.Definition), U64 -> Reading.Definition
definition_at = |definitions, place|
	match definitions.get(place) {
		Ok(found) => found
		Err(_) => crash "Reading: an annotation's place is past the definitions"
	}

## The definitions with the one at `place` replaced.
replaced : List(Reading.Definition), U64, Reading.Definition -> List(Reading.Definition)
replaced = |definitions, place, definition|
	match definitions.set(place, definition) {
		Ok(changed) => changed
		Err(_) => crash "Reading: an annotation's place is past the definitions"
	}

## The annotation `above` given what its definition says.
with_definition : Reading.Definition, Reading.Definition -> Reading.Definition
with_definition = |above, definition| {
	typed = match definition.typed {
		Typed(_) => definition.typed
		Untyped => above.typed
	}
	{
		..above,
		has_definition: Bool.True,
		typed,
		has_callback: above.has_callback or definition.has_callback,
		parameters: definition.parameters,
	}
}

## The line of the declaration that the record field at `at` belongs to, as
## `declaration_lines` holds it so far, or 0 when an expression, a pattern
## or a definition lies between them: the field is then a local's.
field_declaration_line : List(Tree.Node), List(U64), U64 -> U64
field_declaration_line = |nodes, declaration_lines, at| {
	var $up = Tree.node_at(nodes, at).parent
	while $up != 0 {
		node = Tree.node_at(nodes, $up)
		if node.kind.starts_with("e-") or node.kind.starts_with("p-") or node.kind == "s-decl" {
			return 0
		}
		if node.kind == "s-type-anno" or node.kind == "s-type-decl" {
			return declaration_lines.get($up - 1) ?? 0
		}
		$up = node.parent
	}
	0
}

## The name of the type declaration around node `at`, or `""` at the top
## level.
owner_of : List(Tree.Node), U64 -> Str
owner_of = |nodes, at| {
	var $up = Tree.node_at(nodes, at).parent
	while $up != 0 {
		node = Tree.node_at(nodes, $up)
		if node.kind == "s-type-decl" {
			return Tree.attribute(Tree.node_at(nodes, Tree.first_kid(node)), "name")
		}
		$up = node.parent
	}
	""
}

## Whether a `##` doc stands directly above line `line`.
has_doc_above : List(Str), U64 -> Bool
has_doc_above = |source_lines, line| line > 1 and Text.trim(Text.line_at(source_lines, line - 1)).starts_with("##")

## A record with nothing read yet, for the file's node at `at`.
blank_definition : Reading.FileRead, U64, Str -> Reading.Definition
blank_definition = |file, at, name| {
	node = Tree.node_at(file.nodes, at)
	{
		path: file.path,
		line: node.line,
		name,
		owner: owner_of(file.nodes, at),
		is_annotation: Bool.False,
		is_function_type: Bool.False,
		has_callback: Bool.False,
		is_paired: Bool.False,
		has_definition: Bool.False,
		has_doc: has_doc_above(file.source_lines, node.line),
		whole: "",
		result: "",
		first: "",
		arity: -1,
		argument_types: [],
		mentioned_types: Set.empty(),
		arguments: [],
		is_lambda: Bool.False,
		parameters: [],
		recurses: Bool.False,
		typed: Untyped,
	}
}

## The annotation at `at`, unless it is only a `where` clause.
annotation_definition : Reading.FileRead, U64 -> Try(Reading.Definition, [OnlyWhere])
annotation_definition = |file, at| {
	nodes = file.nodes
	node = Tree.node_at(nodes, at)
	type_at = match node.kids.first() {
		Ok(found) => found
		Err(_) => return Err(OnlyWhere)
	}
	type_node = Tree.node_at(nodes, type_at)
	if type_node.kind == "where" {
		return Err(OnlyWhere)
	}
	name = Tree.attribute(node, "name")
	whole = Tree.written_type(nodes, type_at)
	blank = { ..blank_definition(file, at, name), is_annotation: Bool.True, whole, result: whole }
	if type_node.kind != "ty-fn" {
		return Ok(blank)
	}
	is_effect = name.ends_with("!")
	arguments = type_node.kids.drop_last(1)
	Ok({
		..blank,
		is_function_type: Bool.True,
		arity: arguments.len().to_i64_wrap(),
		result: Tree.written_type(nodes, Tree.last_kid(type_node)),
		first: if type_node.kids.len() > 1 {
			Tree.written_type(nodes, Tree.first_kid(type_node))
		} else {
			""
		},
		argument_types: arguments.map(|argument| Tree.written_type(nodes, argument)),
		has_callback: arguments.any(|argument| TypeText.span_text(file.source_lines, Tree.node_at(nodes, argument)).contains("=>")),
		mentioned_types: if is_effect {
			TypeText.mentioned_type_names(nodes, type_at, Set.empty())
		} else {
			Set.empty()
		},
		arguments: if is_effect {
			arguments.map(|argument| TypeText.argument_shape(nodes, argument))
		} else {
			[]
		},
	})
}

## The definition `name = ...` at `at`, unless its pattern is no plain name.
value_definition : Reading.FileRead, U64, Dict(U64, Str) -> Try(Reading.Definition, [NoPlainName])
value_definition = |file, at, pattern_types| {
	nodes = file.nodes
	node = Tree.node_at(nodes, at)
	pattern_at = match node.kids.first() {
		Ok(found) => found
		Err(_) => return Err(NoPlainName)
	}
	pattern = Tree.node_at(nodes, pattern_at)
	if pattern.kind != "p-ident" {
		return Err(NoPlainName)
	}
	name = Tree.attribute(pattern, "raw")
	lambda = match node.kids.get(1) {
		Ok(value_at) if Tree.node_at(nodes, value_at).kind == "e-lambda" => Ok(Tree.node_at(nodes, value_at))
		_ => Err(NoLambda)
	}
	arguments = match lambda {
		Ok(lambda_node) =>
			lambda_node.kids
				.keep_if(|part| Tree.node_at(nodes, part).kind == "args")
				.map(|part| Tree.node_at(nodes, part).kids)
				.join()
		Err(_) => []
	}
	parameter_of = |argument| {
		argument_node = Tree.node_at(nodes, argument)
		parameter_name = if argument_node.kind == "p-ident" {
			Tree.attribute(argument_node, "raw")
		} else {
			""
		}
		typed = if parameter_name != "" {
			pattern_types.get(argument) ?? ""
		} else {
			""
		}
		{ name: parameter_name, line: argument_node.line, typed }
	}
	words = name.drop_suffix("!").split_on("_")
	recurses = words.len() > 1 and Reading.recursion_suffixes.contains(words.last() ?? "") and TypeText.calls_itself(nodes, at, name)
	Ok({
		..blank_definition(file, at, name),
		is_lambda: match lambda {
			Ok(_) => Bool.True
			Err(_) => Bool.False
		},
		parameters: arguments.map(parameter_of),
		has_callback: arguments.any(|argument| Tree.attribute(Tree.node_at(nodes, argument), "raw").ends_with("!")),
		recurses,
		typed: match pattern_types.get(pattern_at) {
			Ok(found) => Typed(found)
			Err(_) => Untyped
		},
	})
}

cookbook/roc/hunt_names/SelfTest.roc, 153 lines

## The recipe's self-test (the Shale original's naming_plants.shale),
## run after the checks over the plants in cookbook/roc/plants/hunt_names/ and its typed/
## folder: each plant is named for the check it holds, and that check must
## fire on it and on no other check's plant; a `quiet_*.roc` plant must draw
## no finding, and a plant named for no check is a failure; the census must
## give one known word of the plants per verdict its verdict; and two plants'
## findings must say something, or must not.
import pf.Shale
import lib.Finding
import lib.Text
import Passes

SelfTest := [].{

	## What the checks found over the plants: the paths read, the findings
	## reported, the census and the finding lines printed.
	Judged : {
		paths : List(Str),
		findings : List(Finding),
		census : Dict(Str, Passes.Counted),
		finding_lines : List(Str),
	}

	## The plants' folder.
	plants : Str
	plants = "cookbook:roc/plants/hunt_names/"

	## The plants' verdict printed, then a stop when any plant is wrong.
	run! : SelfTest.Judged, List(Str) => {}
	run! = |judged, checks| {
		failures = failures_of(judged, checks)
		for failure in failures {
			Shale.print!("FAIL ${failure}")
		}
		if !(failures.is_empty()) {
			Shale.fail!("hunt_names self_test: ${failures.len().to_str()} plants wrong")
		}
		Shale.print!("hunt_names (Roc) self_test: PASS (each check fires on its plants alone, the quiet_ plants on none, and the census gives each verdict its known word)")
	}
}

## Each way the run over the plants is wrong, as a line.
failures_of : SelfTest.Judged, List(Str) -> List(Str)
failures_of = |judged, checks| {
	fired = Set.from_list(judged.findings.map(|finding| "${finding.path}|${finding.check}"))
	var $failures = []
	for check in checks {
		$planted : U64
		var $planted = 0
		for path in judged.paths {
			is_its_plant = is_plant_for(plant_name(path), check)
			if is_its_plant {
				$planted = $planted + 1
			}
			did_fire = fired.contains("${path}|${check}")
			if is_its_plant and !(did_fire) {
				$failures = $failures.append("`${check}` does not fire on its plant ${path}")
			}
			if did_fire and !(is_its_plant) {
				$failures = $failures.append("`${check}` fires on ${path}, another check's plant")
			}
		}
		if $planted == 0 {
			$failures = $failures.append("`${check}` has no plant")
		}
	}
	# A plant named for no check could never fail.
	for path in judged.paths {
		name = plant_name(path)
		if !(name.starts_with("quiet_") or checks.any(|check| is_plant_for(name, check))) {
			$failures = $failures.append("${path}: a plant the table does not judge")
		}
	}
	for known in census_known {
		match judged.census.get(known.word) {
			Ok(counted) if counted.verdict != known.verdict => {
				$failures = $failures.append("the census calls `${known.word}` ${counted.verdict}, not ${known.verdict}")
			}
			Ok(_) => {}
			Err(_) => {
				$failures = $failures.append("the census has no `${known.word}`")
			}
		}
	}
	for expected in plant_says {
		at = "${SelfTest.plants}${expected.plant}:"
		var $is_said = Bool.False
		for line in judged.finding_lines {
			if line.starts_with(at) and line.contains(expected.says) {
				$is_said = Bool.True
			}
			if line.starts_with(at) and line.contains(expected.never) {
				$failures = $failures.append("${line}: says `${expected.never}`")
			}
		}
		if !($is_said) {
			$failures = $failures.append("${expected.plant}: no finding says `${expected.says}`")
		}
	}
	$failures
}

## The census's verdict for one known word of the plants per verdict.
census_known : List({ word : Str, verdict : Str })
census_known = [
	{ word: "read", verdict: "verb" },
	{ word: "held", verdict: "participle" },
	{ word: "process", verdict: "vague" },
	{ word: "links", verdict: "refused" },
]

## The plants whose finding must say something, or must not: `singular_list`
## offers no plural of an adjective, nor `phrase_name` of a preposition's
## noun.
plant_says : List({ plant : Str, says : Str, never : Str })
plant_says = [
	{ plant: "singular_list_adjective.roc", says: "has no noun", never: "stables" },
	{ plant: "phrase_name_list_holder.roc", says: "starts with a preposition, `by`", never: "by_slots" },
]

is_plant_for : Str, Str -> Bool
is_plant_for = |name, check| name == "${check}.roc" or name.starts_with("${check}_")

## A plant's name below the plants' folder. A typed plant is a CamelCase
## module (`typed/QuestionInferred.roc`), as is a plant another imports
## (`QuietDocShelf.roc`), and its name is read in snake case
## (`question_inferred.roc`).
plant_name : Str -> Str
plant_name = |path| {
	name = path.drop_prefix(SelfTest.plants).drop_prefix("typed/")
	match name.to_utf8().first() {
		Ok(byte) if Text.is_capital(byte) => snake_case(name)
		_ => name
	}
}

## A CamelCase file name in snake case: `_` before each capital but a first,
## and the capital made small.
snake_case : Str -> Str
snake_case = |name| {
	var $out = []
	for byte in name.to_utf8() {
		if Text.is_capital(byte) {
			if !($out.is_empty()) {
				$out = $out.append('_')
			}
			$out = $out.append(byte + 32)
		} else {
			$out = $out.append(byte)
		}
	}
	Str.from_utf8_lossy($out)
}

cookbook/roc/hunt_names/ShortNames.roc, 289 lines

## hunt_names' `short_name` for what a file binds inside its definitions:
## each local,
## parameter, match binding, record destructuring and `var` whose name, past
## a `$` or `_` and before a `!`, is one letter. A loop's variable, a
## coordinate, a colour's channels and a triangle's corners pass, as the
## launcher's header says.
import lib.Finding
import lib.Tree

ShortNames := [].{

	## Whether a name of one letter is a coordinate (`x`, `y`, `z`, and `w`
	## beside `x` and `y`), a colour's channel (`r`, `g`, `b`, and `a` beside
	## them) or a triangle's corner (`a`, `b` and `c`, all three), by
	## `siblings`, the names beside it.
	is_letter_of_set : Str, Set(Str) -> Bool
	is_letter_of_set = |name, siblings| {
		has_all = |names| names.all(|sibling| siblings.contains(sibling))
		if ["x", "y", "z"].contains(name) or (name == "w" and has_all(["x", "y"])) {
			Bool.True
		} else if ["a", "b", "c"].contains(name) and has_all(["a", "b", "c"]) {
			Bool.True
		} else {
			["r", "g", "b", "a"].contains(name) and has_all(["r", "g", "b"])
		}
	}

	## The one-letter bindings of the file at `path`, in the tree's order.
	findings : Str, List(Tree.Node) -> List(Finding)
	findings = |path, nodes| {
		tested = while_tested(nodes)
		vars = Set.from_list(nodes.keep_if(|node| node.kind == "s-var").map(|node| Tree.attribute(node, "name")))
		var $found = []
		$at : U64
		var $at = 0
		for node in nodes {
			$at = $at + 1
			name = name_bound_by(nodes, node)
			letters = if name == "" {
				""
			} else {
				without_marks(name)
			}
			if letters.count_utf8_bytes() == 1 {
				binding = { at: $at, name, letters, tested, vars }
				match judged_binding(nodes, binding) {
					Reported(what) => {
						why = "${what} `${name}` is one letter: name what it holds"
						$found = $found.append({ path, line: node.line, check: "short_name", what: why })
					}
					Passed => {}
				}
			}
		}
		$found
	}
}

## A binding of one letter: its node's place, its name, the name's letters,
## and the names a `while` tests and the `var`s the file declares.
Binding : { at : U64, name : Str, letters : Str, tested : Set(Str), vars : Set(Str) }

## What a one-letter binding is called when it is reported, or that it
## passes.
judged_binding : List(Tree.Node), Binding -> [Reported(Str), Passed]
judged_binding = |nodes, binding| {
	node = Tree.node_at(nodes, binding.at)
	is_var = node.kind == "s-var"
	holder = if node.kind == "p-ident" and Tree.node_at(nodes, node.parent).kind == "field" {
		Tree.node_at(nodes, node.parent).parent
	} else {
		node.parent
	}
	binder = binder_of(nodes, node.parent)
	binder_kind = if is_var {
		"s-var"
	} else {
		Tree.node_at(nodes, binder).kind
	}
	siblings = if is_var {
		Set.empty()
	} else {
		bound_siblings(nodes, holder)
	}
	is_record = Tree.node_at(nodes, holder).kind == "p-record"
	is_colour = ["r", "g", "b"].all(|channel| siblings.contains(channel))
	is_corner_outside_record = ["a", "b", "c"].contains(binding.letters) and !(is_record) and !(is_colour)
	is_reassigned_var = binding.name.starts_with("$") and binding.vars.contains(binding.name)
	skip = (binder_kind == "s-decl" and (is_outer_definition(nodes, binder) or is_reassigned_var))
		or (binder_kind == "s-var" and binding.tested.contains(binding.name))
		or binder_kind == "s-for"
		or (binder_kind == "e-lambda" and is_loop_lambda(nodes, binder))
		or (ShortNames.is_letter_of_set(binding.letters, siblings) and !(is_corner_outside_record))
	if skip {
		Passed
	} else if binder_kind == "s-decl" {
		Reported("the local")
	} else if binder_kind == "e-lambda" {
		Reported("the parameter")
	} else if binder_kind == "branch" {
		Reported("the match binding")
	} else if binder_kind == "s-var" {
		Reported("the var")
	} else {
		Reported("the binding")
	}
}

## The names a `while` tests, in any of the file's loops.
while_tested : List(Tree.Node) -> Set(Str)
while_tested = |nodes| {
	var $tested = Set.empty()
	for node in nodes {
		if node.kind == "s-while" {
			match node.kids.first() {
				Ok(condition) => {
					last = subtree_end(nodes, condition)
					var $place = condition
					while $place <= last {
						inner = Tree.node_at(nodes, $place)
						if inner.kind == "e-ident" {
							$tested = $tested.insert(Tree.attribute(inner, "raw"))
						}
						$place = $place + 1
					}
				}
				Err(_) => {}
			}
		}
	}
	$tested
}

## A name past its leading `$`s and `_`s and before a last `!`.
without_marks : Str -> Str
without_marks = |name| {
	bytes = name.to_utf8()
	start = bytes.find_first_index(|byte| byte != '$' and byte != '_') ?? bytes.len()
	Str.from_utf8_lossy(bytes.drop_first(start)).drop_suffix("!")
}

## The last node of the subtree at `at`: the tree is in order, each subtree
## running on while the depth is deeper than its root's.
subtree_end : List(Tree.Node), U64 -> U64
subtree_end = |nodes, at| {
	depth = Tree.node_at(nodes, at).depth
	var $stop = at
	while $stop < nodes.len() and Tree.node_at(nodes, $stop + 1).depth > depth {
		$stop = $stop + 1
	}
	$stop
}

## The kinds of node a pattern sits in on its way up to what binds it.
pattern_holders : List(Str)
pattern_holders = ["args", "field", "p-record", "p-tuple", "p-list", "p-tag", "p-as"]

## Up through the patterns from `start` to what binds them.
binder_of : List(Tree.Node), U64 -> U64
binder_of = |nodes, start| {
	var $binder = start
	while $binder > 0 and pattern_holders.contains(Tree.node_at(nodes, $binder).kind) {
		$binder = Tree.node_at(nodes, $binder).parent
	}
	$binder
}

## The name a node binds, `""` for none: a pattern's name, a record's pun
## (`{ x }`), a list's rest (`.. as rest`) and a `var`.
bound_name : List(Tree.Node), U64 -> Str
bound_name = |nodes, at| name_bound_by(nodes, Tree.node_at(nodes, at))

## The name the node `node` binds.
name_bound_by : List(Tree.Node), Tree.Node -> Str
name_bound_by = |nodes, node| {
	if node.kind == "p-ident" {
		Tree.attribute(node, "raw")
	} else if node.kind == "field" and node.kids.is_empty() and node.parent > 0 and Tree.node_at(nodes, node.parent).kind == "p-record" {
		Tree.attribute(node, "name")
	} else if node.kind == "p-list-rest" or node.kind == "s-var" {
		Tree.attribute(node, "name")
	} else {
		""
	}
}

## The names bound beside a binding in one pattern, `holder`'s: a lambda's
## parameters, a record's fields, a tuple's or a tag's parts. A record's
## field renamed (`{ y: q }`) binds its pattern, beside the record's others.
bound_siblings : List(Tree.Node), U64 -> Set(Str)
bound_siblings = |nodes, holder| {
	var $names = Set.empty()
	for kid in Tree.node_at(nodes, holder).kids {
		name = bound_name(nodes, kid)
		if name != "" {
			$names = $names.insert(name)
		}
		kid_node = Tree.node_at(nodes, kid)
		if kid_node.kind == "field" {
			for inner in kid_node.kids {
				inner_name = bound_name(nodes, inner)
				if inner_name != "" {
					$names = $names.insert(inner_name)
				}
			}
		}
	}
	$names
}

## The kinds of node a definition may sit in and still be top-level or a
## module type's member.
outer_kinds : List(Str)
outer_kinds = ["file", "statements", "s-type-decl", "associated"]

## Whether a definition at `at` is top-level or a module type's member, its
## ancestors all of the outer kinds: its name is judged as a definition's.
is_outer_definition : List(Tree.Node), U64 -> Bool
is_outer_definition = |nodes, at| {
	var $up = Tree.node_at(nodes, at).parent
	while $up > 0 {
		node = Tree.node_at(nodes, $up)
		if !(outer_kinds.contains(node.kind)) {
			return Bool.False
		}
		$up = node.parent
	}
	Bool.True
}

## The list methods whose one-line lambda is a loop's body, so its
## parameters are loop variables.
loop_methods : List(Str)
loop_methods = [
	"map",
	"map2",
	"map3",
	"map_with_index",
	"map_try",
	"keep_if",
	"drop_if",
	"keep_oks",
	"keep_errs",
	"walk",
	"walk_backwards",
	"walk_until",
	"walk_with_index",
	"walk_try",
	"any",
	"all",
	"count_if",
	"find_first",
	"find_last",
	"find_first_index",
	"find_last_index",
	"sort_with",
	"join_map",
	"for_each!",
	"for_each_try!",
	"walk!",
	"walk_try!",
]

## Whether the lambda at `at` is a loop's body: on one line, and the direct
## argument of a list method, as a method call or a module's
## (`List.map(xs, |x| ...)`).
is_loop_lambda : List(Tree.Node), U64 -> Bool
is_loop_lambda = |nodes, at| {
	lambda = Tree.node_at(nodes, at)
	if lambda.line != lambda.end_line {
		return Bool.False
	}
	holder = Tree.node_at(nodes, lambda.parent)
	if holder.kind == "args" and Tree.node_at(nodes, holder.parent).kind == "e-method-call" {
		method = Tree.attribute(Tree.node_at(nodes, holder.parent), "method")
		return loop_methods.contains(method.drop_prefix("."))
	}
	if holder.kind != "e-apply" or holder.kids.first() == Ok(at) {
		return Bool.False
	}
	callee = Tree.node_at(nodes, Tree.first_kid(holder))
	if callee.kind != "e-ident" {
		return Bool.False
	}
	match Tree.attribute(callee, "raw").split_on(".") {
		["List", method] => loop_methods.contains(method)
		_ => Bool.False
	}
}

cookbook/roc/hunt_names/Types.roc, 100 lines

## The effects of a recipe's `types=1`: the tree's Roc found, and roc-types
## (Roc's own checker, https://github.com/showell/roc-types) run on each app
## of `root=`, its pin held to the tree's Roc. Reading and joining its output
## is cookbook/roc/lib/'s RocTypes; this file is the same in check_errors,
## hunt_names and check_boundaries, since a package reaches no effect.
import pf.Shale
import lib.RocTypes
import lib.Text

Types := [].{

	## The OS path of the tree's Roc: the pin in `roc-version` where the run
	## starts, or the self-test's pin, which cookbook/roc/pinned.shale names.
	## `who` names the recipe in a refusal.
	roc_bin! : Str, Bool => Str
	roc_bin! = |who, self_test| {
		pin = if self_test {
			pinned = read_text!(who, "cookbook:roc/pinned.shale")
			must!(RocTypes.self_test_pin(pinned).map_err(|_| "${who}: cookbook/roc/pinned.shale names no SELF_TEST_PIN"))
		} else if Shale.exists!("roc-version") {
			Text.trim(read_text!(who, "roc-version"))
		} else {
			must!(Err("${who}: no roc-version where the run starts: run it from the repository's root, whose roc-version pins its Roc"))
		}
		roc = RocTypes.roc_of_pin(pin)
		if !(Shale.exists!(roc)) {
			must!(Err("${who}: no ${roc}: install Roc ${pin} into ~/tools/roc-${pin}/ (roc-apps's toolchain release carries it)"))
		} else {
			Shale.real!(roc)
		}
	}

	## The types of the nodes of `kind` in the files `paths`, from roc-types
	## run on each app of `root` with the Roc at `roc`, and a line for each
	## file no app reaches, except those in `exempt`.
	gather! : { who : Str, kind : RocTypes.Kind, root : Str, roc : Str, paths : List(Str), exempt : Set(Str) } => { typing : RocTypes.Typing, unreached : List(Str) }
	gather! = |asked| {
		roots = must!(RocTypes.root_apps(asked.who, asked.root))
		var $by_module = Dict.empty()
		for root in roots {
			got = modules_of!(root, asked.roc)
			$by_module = RocTypes.joined($by_module, got, asked.kind)
			for warning in got.warnings {
				Shale.print!("${asked.who}: roc-types ${root}: ${warning}")
			}
		}
		var $named = []
		for path in asked.paths {
			$named = $named.append({ path, real: Shale.real!(path) })
		}
		RocTypes.typing_of({ by_module: $by_module, named: $named, exempt: asked.exempt, roots })
	}
}

## The modules roc-types reports for the app `root`, built with the Roc at
## `roc`, or a stop: roc-types missing, of another format, built for another
## Roc, or refusing the app.
modules_of! : Str, Str => RocTypes.Modules
modules_of! = |root, roc| {
	pinned = RocTypes.pinned_checker(roc) ?? RocTypes.default_checker
	exe = if Shale.exists!(pinned) {
		pinned
	} else {
		RocTypes.default_checker
	}
	if !(Shale.exists!(exe)) {
		Shale.fail!("`roc_types`: no ${exe}: ${RocTypes.install_hint}")
	}
	ran = Shale.run!({
		argv: [Shale.real!(exe), Shale.real!(root)],
		keep: Whole(64000000),
		timeout_ms: 300000,
		want: "",
	})
	output_lines = Text.lines(ran.out)
	pin = must!(RocTypes.pin_of(output_lines, root))
	own = RocTypes.roc_of_pin(pin)
	if !(Shale.exists!(own)) or Shale.real!(own) != roc {
		Shale.fail!(RocTypes.another_compiler(pin, root, roc))
	}
	must!(RocTypes.modules_ran(output_lines, ran.code, root))
}

read_text! : Str, Str => Str
read_text! = |who, path|
	match Shale.read!(path) {
		Found(text) => text
