## `Hue` declared in `Peers`'s block).
declared_name : Source.File, U64 -> Str
declared_name = |file, place| {
	var $names = []
	var $at = place
	while $at > 0 {
		node = Source.node_at(file, $at)
		if node.kind == "s-type-decl" {
			$names = $names.prepend(Source.kid_node(file, node, 1).name)
		}
		$at = node.parent
	}
	Str.join_with($names, ".")
}

## The type `type_text` with every alias in it read through, its runs of
## space made one, up to 8 aliases deep.
resolved_type : Str, Dict(Str, Str), U64 -> Str
resolved_type = |type_text, aliases, depth| {
	bytes = type_text.to_utf8()
	var $out = []
	var $changed = Bool.False
	var $place = 0
	while $place < bytes.len() {
		length = type_name_length(bytes, $place)
		if length == 0 {
			$out = $out.append(bytes.get($place) ?? 0)
			$place = $place + 1
		} else {
			name = Str.from_utf8_lossy(bytes.sublist({ start: $place, len: length }))
			match aliases.get(name) {
				Ok(named) => {
					$out = $out.concat(named.to_utf8())
					$changed = Bool.True
				}
				Err(_) => {
					$out = $out.concat(name.to_utf8())
				}
			}
			$place = $place + length
		}
	}
	spaced = Str.from_utf8_lossy(one_space(Text.trim(Str.from_utf8_lossy($out)).to_utf8()))
	if $changed and depth < 8 {
		resolved_type(spaced, aliases, depth + 1)
	} else {
		spaced
	}
}

## The bytes with each run of white space made one space.
one_space : List(U8) -> List(U8)
one_space = |bytes| {
	var $out = []
	var $in_space = Bool.False
	for byte in bytes {
		if is_space(byte) {
			if !($in_space) {
				$out = $out.append(' ')
			}
			$in_space = Bool.True
		} else {
			$out = $out.append(byte)
			$in_space = Bool.False
		}
	}
	$out
}

is_space : U8 -> Bool
is_space = |byte| byte == ' ' or byte == '\t' or byte == '\n' or byte == '\r' or byte == 11 or byte == 12

## The length of the type name at byte `start`, as roc-types writes one
## (`U64`, `List`, `Shelf.Book`): a capital, then letters, digits and `_`,
## and again after each `.` that a capital follows; 0 where none starts.
type_name_length : List(U8), U64 -> U64
type_name_length = |bytes, start| {
	if !(Text.is_capital(bytes.get(start) ?? 0)) {
		return 0
	}
	var $end = word_end(bytes, start + 1)
	while (bytes.get($end) ?? 0) == '.' and Text.is_capital(bytes.get($end + 1) ?? 0) {
		$end = word_end(bytes, $end + 2)
	}
	$end - start
}

## The place past the letters, digits and `_` from `start` on.
word_end : List(U8), U64 -> U64
word_end = |bytes, start| {
	var $end = start
	while is_word_byte(bytes.get($end) ?? 0) {
		$end = $end + 1
	}
	$end
}

is_word_byte : U8 -> Bool
is_word_byte = |byte| Text.is_capital(byte) or Text.is_small_letter(byte) or Text.is_digit(byte) or byte == '_'

## Whether the bytes are a function's name: a small letter, then small
## letters, digits and `_`, and an optional last `!`.
is_function_name : List(U8) -> Bool
is_function_name = |bytes| {
	body = if (bytes.last() ?? 0) == '!' {
		bytes.drop_last(1)
	} else {
		bytes
	}
	match body.first() {
		Ok(first) => Text.is_small_letter(first) and body.all(|byte| Text.is_small_letter(byte) or Text.is_digit(byte) or byte == '_')
		Err(_) => Bool.False
	}
}

cookbook/roc/rewrite_method_calls/Source.roc, 158 lines

## A file as the rewrite reads it: Roc's tree of it, each node's span as byte
## offsets into its text, and where each line starts, so a byte's line is
## found and a span's text cut out.
import lib.Tree

Source := [].{

	## A node of the file's tree: its kind and the attributes the rewrite
	## reads (`""` where the tree gives none), its span as byte offsets
	## (`from` its first byte, counted from 1, `to` one past its last, both 0
	## and `has_span` false for a node with no position), its kids and
	## parent as places counted from 1 (the root's parent 0), and its region
	## as the compiler writes it, `line:col:end_line:end_col`, by which its
	## type is found.
	Node : {
		kind : Str,
		raw : Str,
		name : Str,
		field : Str,
		method : Str,
		from : U64,
		to : U64,
		has_span : Bool,
		kids : List(U64),
		parent : U64,
		region : Str,
	}

	## A file: its path, its text (and its bytes), its nodes, and the byte at
	## which each line starts, counted from 1, with one more past the end.
	File : {
		path : Str,
		text : Str,
		bytes : List(U8),
		nodes : List(Source.Node),
		starts : List(U64),
	}

	## The file at `path`, of text `text`, as Roc's tree of it reads.
	of : Str, Str, List(Tree.Node) -> Source.File
	of = |path, text, tree_nodes| {
		bytes = text.to_utf8()
		starts = line_starts(bytes)
		nodes = tree_nodes.map(|tree_node| node_of(tree_node, starts))
		{ path, text, bytes, nodes, starts }
	}

	## The node at a place counted from 1.
	node_at : Source.File, U64 -> Source.Node
	node_at = |file, place|
		match file.nodes.get(place - 1) {
			Ok(node) => node
			Err(_) => crash "Source.node_at: ${file.path} has no node ${place.to_str()}"
		}

	## The place of a node's kid, the kids counted from 1.
	kid : Source.Node, U64 -> U64
	kid = |node, number|
		match node.kids.get(number - 1) {
			Ok(place) => place
			Err(_) => crash "Source.kid: a ${node.kind} with no kid ${number.to_str()}"
		}

	## The node that is a node's kid, the kids counted from 1.
	kid_node : Source.File, Source.Node, U64 -> Source.Node
	kid_node = |file, node, number| Source.node_at(file, Source.kid(node, number))

	## The line the byte at `offset` is on: the last line starting at or
	## before it, and line 1 for an offset before the first.
	line_of_offset : Source.File, U64 -> U64
	line_of_offset = |file, offset| {
		var $low = 0
		var $high = file.starts.len()
		while $low < $high {
			middle = ($low + $high) // 2
			if (file.starts.get(middle) ?? 0) <= offset {
				$low = middle + 1
			} else {
				$high = middle
			}
		}
		if $low == 0 {
			1
		} else {
			$low
		}
	}

	## The bytes from offset `from` up to, not including, `to`; none when
	## `to` is not past `from`.
	bytes_between : Source.File, U64, U64 -> List(U8)
	bytes_between = |file, from, to|
		if to > from and from > 0 {
			file.bytes.sublist({ start: from - 1, len: to - from })
		} else {
			[]
		}

	## The text from offset `from` up to, not including, `to`.
	text_between : Source.File, U64, U64 -> Str
	text_between = |file, from, to| Str.from_utf8_lossy(Source.bytes_between(file, from, to))

	## A node's text.
	text_of : Source.File, Source.Node -> Str
	text_of = |file, node| Source.text_between(file, node.from, node.to)
}

## The byte at which each line starts, counted from 1, and one more past the
## last line's end, as method_text.shale's `line_starts` counts them.
line_starts : List(U8) -> List(U64)
line_starts = |bytes| {
	var $starts = [1]
	$at : U64
	var $at = 0
	for byte in bytes {
		$at = $at + 1
		if byte == '\n' {
			$starts = $starts.append($at + 1)
		}
	}
	$starts.append(bytes.len() + 2)
}

## A node of Roc's tree with its span made byte offsets.
node_of : Tree.Node, List(U64) -> Source.Node
node_of = |tree_node, starts| {
	start_of = |line|
		match starts.get(line - 1) {
			Ok(start) => start
			Err(_) => crash "Source: a node on line ${line.to_str()}, past the file's end"
		}
	has_span = tree_node.line != 0
	from = if has_span {
		start_of(tree_node.line) + tree_node.column - 1
	} else {
		0
	}
	to = if has_span {
		start_of(tree_node.end_line) + tree_node.end_column - 1
	} else {
		0
	}
	starts_at = "${tree_node.line.to_str()}:${tree_node.column.to_str()}"
	ends_at = "${tree_node.end_line.to_str()}:${tree_node.end_column.to_str()}"
	{
		kind: tree_node.kind,
		raw: Tree.attribute(tree_node, "raw"),
		name: Tree.attribute(tree_node, "name"),
		field: Tree.attribute(tree_node, "field"),
		method: Tree.attribute(tree_node, "method"),
		from,
		to,
		has_span,
		kids: tree_node.kids,
		parent: tree_node.parent,
		region: "${starts_at}:${ends_at}",
	}
}

cookbook/roc/rewrite_method_calls/Tally.roc, 69 lines

## What a run has done so far: the programs it started, its checks, the
## files the confirm kept, the rewrites that passed (for what they leave the
## sweep), the kinds of type the types found, and the roots they were read
## of.
import Candidates
import Judging
import Rewritten
import Source

Tally := [].{

	## A rewrite that passed: the text before and after it, before any `roc
	## fmt`, and the lines after it where a turned call that spanned several
	## lines now sits on one.
	Rewrite : { before : Str, after : Str, joined : List(U64) }

	## The run's sheet.
	Sheet : {
		programs_used : U64,
		rounds : U64,
		confirms : U64,
		confirmed : Dict(Str, U64),
		rewrites : Dict(Str, Tally.Rewrite),
		kind_counts : Judging.KindCounts,
		typed_roots : List(Str),
	}

	## Nothing done yet.
	empty : Tally.Sheet
	empty = {
		programs_used: 0,
		rounds: 0,
		confirms: 0,
		confirmed: Dict.empty(),
		rewrites: Dict.empty(),
		kind_counts: [],
		typed_roots: [],
	}

	## One program more.
	ran : Tally.Sheet -> Tally.Sheet
	ran = |tally| { ..tally, programs_used: tally.programs_used + 1 }

	## The rewrite of the file with the candidates `turned` turned, by a
	## passing trial or confirm, or under `trials=0` the proven calls: noted
	## when it changes the text.
	noted : Tally.Sheet, Source.File, List(Candidates.Candidate) -> Tally.Sheet
	noted = |tally, file, turned| {
		turning = Candidates.turning(turned)
		written = Rewritten.written(file, turning)
		var $joined = []
		for cand in turned {
			if turning.contains(cand.node) {
				lines = written.turned_lines.get(cand.node) ?? { from_line: cand.from_line, to_line: cand.to_line }
				node = Source.node_at(file, cand.node)
				spanned_lines = Source.line_of_offset(file, node.from) < Source.line_of_offset(file, node.to - 1)
				if lines.from_line == lines.to_line and spanned_lines {
					$joined = $joined.append(lines.from_line)
				}
			}
		}
		if written.text == file.text {
			tally
		} else {
			rewrite = { before: file.text, after: written.text, joined: $joined }
			{ ..tally, rewrites: tally.rewrites.insert(file.path, rewrite) }
		}
	}
}

cookbook/roc/rewrite_method_calls/Trial.roc, 181 lines

## The compiler's judgement of a rewrite: one file's open calls tried round
## by round until `roc check` passes (the trial), and the files whose calls
## the types all prove written at once and checked together (the confirm).
## A file ends as it began unless `apply` and its rewrite passed.
import pf.Shale
import Candidates
import Compiler
import Rewritten
import Source
import Tally
import lib.Text

Trial := [].{

	## The Roc that judges, and whether a rewrite that passes is kept.
	Judge : { roc : Str, apply : Bool }

	## A file the confirm writes: its path, its tree and its candidates.
	Proven : { path : Str, file : Source.File, cands : List(Candidates.Candidate) }

	## Tries one file's open candidates, round by round, until `roc check` on
	## `root` passes or nothing is left to try, then runs the test, which
	## must say `baseline`. Answers how many calls were turned, and the
	## candidates, each that stays with its `why_left`.
	try_file! : Trial.Judge, Tally.Sheet, Source.File, List(Candidates.Candidate), Str, Str => { tally : Tally.Sheet, cands : List(Candidates.Candidate), turned : U64 }
	try_file! = |judge, tally, file, cands, root, baseline| {
		var $tally = tally
		fmt_was_clean = if judge.apply {
			$tally = Tally.ran($tally)
			Compiler.is_fmt_clean!(judge.roc, file.path)
		} else {
			Bool.False
		}
		var $cands = cands
		var $round = 0
		while $round < max_rounds {
			$round = $round + 1
			open = Candidates.open_count($cands)
			if open == 0 {
				Shale.write!(file.path, file.text)
				return { tally: $tally, cands: $cands, turned: 0 }
			}
			written = Rewritten.written(file, Candidates.turning($cands))
			$cands = Candidates.with_lines($cands, written)
			Shale.write!(file.path, written.text)
			$tally = Tally.ran({ ..$tally, rounds: $tally.rounds + 1 })
			checked = Compiler.check!(judge.roc, root)
			if checked.ok {
				if fmt_was_clean {
					$tally = Tally.ran($tally)
					Compiler.fmt!(judge.roc, file.path)
				}
				$tally = Tally.ran($tally)
				summary = Compiler.test_summary!(judge.roc, root)
				if summary != baseline {
					why = "roc test changed: ${summary}, was ${baseline}; the file is put back"
					Shale.write!(file.path, file.text)
					return { tally: $tally, cands: Candidates.leave_open($cands, why), turned: 0 }
				}
				$tally = Tally.noted($tally, file, $cands)
				if !(judge.apply) {
					Shale.write!(file.path, file.text)
				}
				return { tally: $tally, cands: $cands, turned: open }
			}
			judged = judge_errors(file, written.line_of_node, checked.errors, $cands)
			$cands = judged.cands
			if !(judged.refused) and (judged.stray != NoStray or checked.errors.is_empty()) {
				why = match judged.stray {
					Stray(stray) => "roc check: ${stray.title} at ${stray.file}:${stray.line.to_str()}, on no rewritten call"
					NoStray => "roc check failed, naming no line: ${Compiler.first_line_said(checked.out)}"
				}
				Shale.write!(file.path, file.text)
				return { tally: $tally, cands: Candidates.leave_open($cands, "${why}; the file is put back"), turned: 0 }
			}
			$cands = Candidates.without_lines($cands)
		}
		Shale.write!(file.path, file.text)
		why = "still failing after ${max_rounds.to_str()} rounds; the file is put back"
		{ tally: $tally, cands: Candidates.leave_open($cands, why), turned: 0 }
	}

	## Confirms the files whose open calls are all proven: written with all
	## their calls turned, at once, and judged together by one `roc check` on
	## `root` and one `roc test`. When the check fails, the files its errors
	## name are set aside and the rest written again, up to `max_rounds`
	## checks; an error in no file of theirs (a caller's), a failure naming no
	## line, or a changed test sets them all aside. `confirmed` holds each
	## kept file's count of turned calls, and 0 for a file set aside, which
	## the trial then judges alone.
	confirm! : Trial.Judge, Tally.Sheet, Str, List(Trial.Proven), Str => Tally.Sheet
	confirm! = |judge, tally, root, files, baseline| {
		var $tally = tally
		var $remaining = []
		for proven in files {
			$tally = { ..$tally, confirmed: $tally.confirmed.insert(proven.path, 0) }
			fmt_was_clean = if judge.apply {
				$tally = Tally.ran($tally)
				Compiler.is_fmt_clean!(judge.roc, proven.path)
			} else {
				Bool.False
			}
			$remaining = $remaining.append({ proven, fmt_was_clean, turned: Candidates.open_count(proven.cands) })
		}
		var $round = 0
		while $round < max_rounds {
			$round = $round + 1
			if $remaining.is_empty() {
				return $tally
			}
			for one in $remaining {
				Shale.write!(one.proven.path, Rewritten.written(one.proven.file, Candidates.turning(one.proven.cands)).text)
			}
			$tally = Tally.ran({ ..$tally, confirms: $tally.confirms + 1 })
			checked = Compiler.check!(judge.roc, root)
			if checked.ok {
				for one in $remaining {
					if one.fmt_was_clean {
						$tally = Tally.ran($tally)
						Compiler.fmt!(judge.roc, one.proven.path)
					}
				}
				$tally = Tally.ran($tally)
				passed = Compiler.test_summary!(judge.roc, root) == baseline
				for one in $remaining {
					if passed {
						$tally = Tally.noted($tally, one.proven.file, one.proven.cands)
					}
					if !(passed) or !(judge.apply) {
						Shale.write!(one.proven.path, one.proven.file.text)
					}
					if passed {
						$tally = { ..$tally, confirmed: $tally.confirmed.insert(one.proven.path, one.turned) }
					}
				}
				return $tally
			}
			for one in $remaining {
				Shale.write!(one.proven.path, one.proven.file.text)
			}
			named = |one| checked.errors.any(|error| Text.basename(one.proven.path) == error.file)
			names_another = |error| !($remaining.any(|one| Text.basename(one.proven.path) == error.file))
			if checked.errors.is_empty() or checked.errors.any(names_another) {
				return $tally
			}
			$remaining = $remaining.drop_if(named)
		}
		$tally
	}

	## How many checks a file may take: each round leaves out the calls the
	## compiler refused, and the next may find more that their errors hid.
	max_rounds : U64
	max_rounds = 6
}

## A failed round's errors laid on the file's turned calls. An error on no
## turned call is a stray, and counts only in a round that refused no call:
## the compiler may complain where a refused call's value is used, and the
## next round, without that call, shows whether the stray was its.
judge_errors : Source.File, Dict(U64, U64), List(Candidates.CheckError), List(Candidates.Candidate) -> { cands : List(Candidates.Candidate), refused : Bool, stray : [Stray(Candidates.CheckError), NoStray] }
judge_errors = |file, line_of_node, errors, cands| {
	var $cands = cands
	var $refused = Bool.False
	var $stray = NoStray
	own = Text.basename(file.path)
	for error in errors {
		if error.file == own {
			blamed = Candidates.blame(file, line_of_node, error, $cands)
			$cands = blamed.cands
			if blamed.hit {
				$refused = Bool.True
			} else if $stray == NoStray {
				$stray = Stray(error)
			}
		} else if $stray == NoStray {
			$stray = Stray(error)
		}
	}
	{ cands: $cands, refused: $refused, stray: $stray }
}

cookbook/roc/rewrite_method_calls/Types.roc, 132 lines

## Every expression's type in an app, from roc-types (Roc's own checker,
## https://github.com/showell/roc-types) run on the root with its pin held
## to the tree's Roc, or read from a file a gate kept, and read by
## cookbook/roc/lib/'s RocTypes. Each refusal is worded as the Shale
## original's.
import pf.Shale
import Compiler
import lib.RocTypes
import lib.Text

Types := [].{

	## An app's types: each expression's type keyed by `<real path>|<region>`
	## (where several share a region, the first roc-types gives, the
	## outermost), and the real paths of the modules it reaches.
	Typed : { by_region : Dict(Str, Str), modules : Set(Str) }

	## The types of the app `root`, from roc-types run with the Roc at `roc`,
	## or from `types_from` when it names a file (its records kept for the
	## modules in `only` alone). roc-types' warnings are printed.
	of_root! : { root : Str, roc : Str, types_from : Str, only : Set(Str) } => Types.Typed
	of_root! = |asked| {
		got = if asked.types_from == "" {
			from_run!(asked.root, asked.roc)
		} else {
			from_file!(asked.types_from, asked.root, asked.roc, asked.only)
		}
		var $by_region = Dict.empty()
		for path in got.paths {
			for record in got.records.get(path) ?? [] {
				key = "${path}|${record.span}"
				if record.kind == "expr" and !($by_region.contains(key)) {
					$by_region = $by_region.insert(key, record.written)
				}
			}
		}
		for warning in got.warnings {
			Shale.print!("rewrite_method_calls: roc-types ${asked.root}: ${warning}")
		}
		{ by_region: $by_region, modules: Set.from_list(got.paths) }
	}

	## The checker for the compiler at `roc`: the one installed for its pin,
	## `tools:roc-types-<pin>/bin/roc-types`, as compilers sit side by side,
	## or else the default.
	checker_for! : Str => Str
	checker_for! = |roc|
		match Shale.re_find!(roc, "/roc-([^/]+)/roc$") {
			Found(matched) => {
				own = "tools:roc-types-${matched.groups.first() ?? ""}/bin/roc-types"
				if Shale.exists!(own) {
					own
				} else {
					default_checker
				}
			}
			NoMatch => default_checker
		}

	## The default checker, which the self-test needs installed.
	default_checker : Str
	default_checker = "tools:roc-types/bin/roc-types"
}

## roc-types run on `root`: a stop when it is missing, of another format,
## built for another Roc than `roc`, or refusing the app.
from_run! : Str, Str => RocTypes.Modules
from_run! = |root, roc| {
	exe = Types.checker_for!(roc)
	if !(Shale.exists!(exe)) {
		Shale.fail!("`roc_types`: no ${exe}: ${RocTypes.install_hint}")
	}
	ran = Shale.run!({
		argv: [Shale.real!(exe), Shale.real!(root)],
		keep: Whole(64000000),
		timeout_ms: 300000,
		want: "",
	})
	modules_said!(Text.lines(ran.out), ran.code, root, roc)
}

## The types roc-types wrote of `root` to the file `path`, read with no
## program run: the records of the modules in `only` alone, every module's
## `== ` line kept, so the modules reached stay whole.
from_file! : Str, Str, Str, Set(Str) => RocTypes.Modules
from_file! = |path, root, roc, only| {
	if !(Shale.exists!(path)) {
		Shale.fail!("`roc_types`: no ${path}, the types of ${root} to read")
	}
	var $kept = []
	var $keeping = Bool.True
	for said in Text.lines(Compiler.read_text!(path)) {
		if said.starts_with("== ") {
			$keeping = only.contains(said.drop_prefix("== "))
			$kept = $kept.append(said)
		} else if $keeping or $kept.is_empty() {
			$kept = $kept.append(said)
		}
	}
	modules_said!($kept, 0, root, roc)
}

## roc-types' lines read, its pin held to `roc` first, since the errors (or
## the silence) of a checker from another Roc say nothing about this tree,
## then its exit `code`.
modules_said! : List(Str), I64, Str, Str => RocTypes.Modules
modules_said! = |output_lines, code, root, roc| {
	pin = match RocTypes.pin_of(output_lines, root) {
		Ok(found) => found
		Err(why) => Compiler.stop!(why)
	}
	own = "tools:roc-${pin}/roc"
	if !(Shale.exists!(own)) or Shale.real!(own) != roc {
		another = "its types would be another compiler's. Install the roc-types of the tree's pin (https://github.com/showell/roc-types), or move the tree to ${pin}"
		Shale.fail!("`roc_types`: roc-types reads Roc ${pin}, and ${root}'s tree is built with ${roc}: ${another}")
	}
	if code != 0 {
		ended = if code < 0 {
			"did not exit"
		} else {
			"exited ${code.to_str()}"
		}
		Shale.fail!("`roc_types`: roc-types ${root} ${ended}, what it said:\n${RocTypes.said_on_failure(output_lines)}")
	}
	match RocTypes.modules_of(output_lines) {
		Ok(modules) => modules
		Err(why) => {
			Shale.fail!(why)
			{ paths: [], records: Dict.empty(), warnings: [] }
		}
	}
}

cookbook/roc/rewrite_method_calls/Plants.roc, 145 lines

## What each plant in cookbook/roc/plants/rewrite_method_calls/ must come to
## (rewrite_method_calls.shale's `EXPECT`), and the plants that serve only
## as roots for others.
Plants := [].{

	## A plant's expectation: how many calls it must leave (`left`), a
	## reason one of them must give (`why`), the root it is judged on
	## (`root`, the plant itself when `""`), whether it runs with the types,
	## and how many confirms and trial rounds it takes. A plant with `file`
	## judges that plant's file under its own name, one with `with` reads a
	## second plant beside it, as a glob of two files would, and one with
	## `stop` must stop its run with that text. A `count` plant runs
	## `trials=0` and must count `proven` and `unsettled` calls.
	Expect : {
		name : Str,
		file : Str,
		beside : Str,
		left : U64,
		why : Str,
		root : Str,
		types : Bool,
		confirms : U64,
		rounds : [Rounds(U64), AnyRounds],
		no_types_run : Bool,
		unreached : U64,
		stop : Str,
		tree_pin : Str,
		count : Bool,
		proven : U64,
		unsettled : U64,
		types_from : Bool,
		peers : [Peers(U64), AnyPeers],
		undo : Bool,
		made_unused : U64,
		made_long : U64,
		made_says : Str,
	}

	## Every plant's expectation, in the table's order.
	table : List(Plants.Expect)
	table = [
		{ ..plain("Rewrite"), left: 0 },
		{ ..plain("Chained"), left: 0 },
		{ ..plain("FunctionValue"), left: 0 },
		{ ..plain("Pipe"), left: 1, why: "the right of a `|>`" },
		{ ..plain("Own"), left: 0 },
		{ ..plain("OtherType"), left: 1, why: "roc check: missing method" },
		{ ..plain("Decode"), left: 1, why: "on no rewritten call; the file is put back", root: "Breaks" },
		{ ..plain("Breaks"), left: 1, why: "roc check: missing method" },
		{ ..plain("Matched"), left: 1, why: "an argument with no span" },
		{ ..plain("Literal"), left: 8, why: "a number literal's type would default as a receiver" },
		{ ..plain("Ref"), left: 0 },
		{ ..plain("Scrutinee"), left: 1, why: "roc check: missing method (on `text`'s definition)" },
		{ ..plain("Knock"), left: 2, why: "roc check: missing method" },
		{ ..plain("Header"), left: 0 },
		{ ..typed("Typed", "TypedApp", 1, 0), left: 1, why: "the first argument is a List, not a Str" },
		{ ..typed("Proven", "TypedApp", 1, 0), left: 0 },
		{ ..typed("NoCalls", "TypedApp", 0, 0), left: 0, no_types_run: Bool.True },
		{ ..typed("ProvenFails", "TypedApp", 1, 2), left: 2, why: "roc check: type mismatch" },
		{ ..plain("Unrooted"), types: Bool.True, stop: "the types need root=" },
		{ ..plain("NotApp"), types: Bool.True, root: "Proven", stop: "is not an app" },
		{ ..plain("Pin"), types: Bool.True, root: "TypedApp", stop: "roc-types reads Roc nightly-2026-11-03-34bd006", tree_pin: "nightly-2026-10-29-a0a9fc2" },
		{ ..typed("Second", "TypedApp,SecondApp", 1, 0), left: 0 },
		# A file no root reaches is listed, and the run goes on to the next.
		{ ..typed("Unreached", "TypedApp,SecondApp", 1, 0), file: "Proven", beside: "Unreached", left: 0, unreached: 1 },
		{ ..typed("Beside", "TypedApp", 1, 0), file: "Proven", beside: "NoCalls", left: 0 },
		# A qualified type whose last segment names the module proves nothing,
		# and the compiler agrees: the trial refuses both calls.
		{ ..typed("LastSegment", "TypedApp", 0, 0), left: 2, why: "the first argument is a Shelf.Book, not a Book" },
		{ ..plain("LastSegmentTried"), file: "LastSegment", left: 2, why: "roc check: missing method" },
		# A package's type module, imported as `pk.Meter`, proves its calls.
		{ ..typed("Packaged", "PkgApp", 1, 0), left: 0 },
		# `trials=0`: the types alone count, and the plant comes out as it was.
		# ProvenFails' three calls are all proven, where the trial leaves two:
		# the count's cost, held here.
		{ ..counted("TypedCount", "Typed", 1), left: 1, why: "the first argument is a List, not a Str" },
		{ ..counted("ProvenFailsCount", "ProvenFails", 3), left: 0 },
		{ ..counted("ProvenFrom", "Proven", 2), types_from: Bool.True, left: 0 },
		{ ..counted("LastSegmentCount", "LastSegment", 0), left: 2, why: "the first argument is a Shelf.Shelf, not a Shelf" },
		{ ..counted("PackagedCount", "Packaged", 1), root: "PkgApp", left: 0 },
		# A symmetric function's peer calls stay module calls; `peers=undo`
		# turns its peer method calls back; every other function's calls turn
		# or stay as ever. Each `count` plant's `left` counts its listed lines,
		# the peer_receiver findings among them. Line 24 of each is the alias's.
		{ ..typed("Peers", "TypedApp", 1, 0), left: 6, why: "Peers.roc:24: U64.max: peers: `max` is symmetric and both arguments are U64s, so neither is the subject", peers: Peers(0) },
		{ ..counted("PeersCount", "Peers", 5), left: 6, peers: Peers(0), why: "Peers.roc:24: U64.max: peers: `max` is symmetric" },
		{ ..typed("PeerMethods", "TypedApp", 1, 0), undo: Bool.True, left: 0, peers: Peers(0) },
		# What a rewrite leaves for the sweep, reported and not fixed: an import
		# it made unused, and a line it pushed past 100 columns; KeptImport is
		# MadeUnused's near miss, an import a type still names.
		{ ..plain("MadeUnused"), left: 0, made_unused: 1, made_says: "MadeUnused.roc:4: made_unused_import: `Ref` was used only by the calls the rewrite turned" },
		{ ..plain("KeptImport"), left: 0 },
		{ ..plain("MadeLong"), left: 0, made_long: 1, made_says: "MadeLong.roc:11: made_long_line" },
		{ ..counted("PeerMethodsCount", "PeerMethods", 0), left: 6, peers: Peers(6), why: "PeerMethods.roc:24: peer_receiver: `.max` is symmetric and its receiver and first argument are both U64s, so neither is the subject: U64.max(...)" },
		# A rewrite `roc check` passes and `roc test` refuses puts the file back;
		# a root that fails `roc check` before any rewrite stops the run; a file
		# `roc fmt` would change is not formatted after its rewrite.
		{ ..plain("TestChanged"), left: 2, why: "roc test changed: " },
		{ ..plain("BadBase"), stop: "fails before any rewrite: fix it first" },
		{ ..plain("Unformatted"), left: 0 },
		{ ..plain("Loud"), left: 0 },
	]

	## The plants that hold no call and serve only as roots for other
	## plants: roc-types reads an app, and an app names its platform.
	root_plants : List(Str)
	root_plants = ["TypedApp", "TypedPf", "SecondApp", "PkgApp", "PlantPkg", "Meter", "Shelf", "Book", "Hues"]
}

## A plant run with `types=0` on itself, that must leave nothing.
plain : Str -> Plants.Expect
plain = |name| {
	name,
	file: "",
	beside: "",
	left: 0,
	why: "",
	root: "",
	types: Bool.False,
	confirms: 0,
	rounds: AnyRounds,
	no_types_run: Bool.False,
	unreached: 0,
	stop: "",
	tree_pin: "",
	count: Bool.False,
	proven: 0,
	unsettled: 0,
	types_from: Bool.False,
	peers: AnyPeers,
	undo: Bool.False,
	made_unused: 0,
	made_long: 0,
	made_says: "",
}

## A plant run with the types on `root`, taking `confirms` confirms and
## `rounds` trial rounds.
typed : Str, Str, U64, U64 -> Plants.Expect
typed = |name, root, confirms, rounds| { ..plain(name), root, types: Bool.True, confirms, rounds: Rounds(rounds) }

## A plant `file` counted under `trials=0` on TypedApp, with `proven` calls
## proven and none unsettled.
counted : Str, Str, U64 -> Plants.Expect
counted = |name, file, proven| { ..plain(name), file, root: "TypedApp", types: Bool.True, count: Bool.True, proven }

cookbook/roc/rewrite_method_calls/Literals.roc, 203 lines

## Whether a value's type comes from unsuffixed number literals alone, read
## from the file's tree (number_literals.shale). Such a value's type
## defaults (to `Dec`) when it is a method call's receiver, so
## `U64.to_str(5)` is "5" while `(5).to_str()` is "5.0", and such a call
## stays as it is.
import Source

Literals := [].{

	## Whether node `place` is a constant numeric expression: untyped number
	## literals (`5`, `-3`, `0x1F`, `1.5`, `'a'`; not `5.U64`) joined only by
	## operators and parentheses (a one-element tuple), as in `5`, `(5)`,
	## `2 + 3` or `-(1 + 2)`.
	is_constant_numeric : Source.File, U64 -> Bool
	is_constant_numeric = |file, place| {
		node = Source.node_at(file, place)
		if untyped_number_literals.contains(node.kind) {
			Bool.True
		} else {
			joins = node.kind == "e-binop" or node.kind == "unary" or (node.kind == "e-tuple" and node.kids.len() == 1)
			joins and !(node.kids.is_empty()) and node.kids.all(|kid| Literals.is_constant_numeric(file, kid))
		}
	}

	## The name a definition `name = <value>` binds, or `""` for any other
	## node.
	defined_name : Source.File, Source.Node -> Str
	defined_name = |file, node|
		if node.kind == "s-decl" and node.kids.len() == 2 {
			pattern = Source.kid_node(file, node, 1)
			if pattern.kind == "p-ident" {
				pattern.raw
			} else {
				""
			}
		} else {
			""
		}

	## Whether the value at node `place` takes its type from unsuffixed
	## number literals alone, so that as a receiver it defaults: a constant
	## numeric expression; a plain name bound, unannotated, to one, or to
	## another such name; a loop variable over a list of them or a range of
	## literals (`for n in [10, 1000]`, `for k in 0..<3`); a `var` whose start
	## is one; or a field of a record literal that holds one (`r.a` after
	## `r = { a: 5 }`).
	takes_literal_type : Source.File, U64 -> Bool
	takes_literal_type = |file, place| takes(file, place, Number, 0)
}

## The number literals whose type only their use fixes.
untyped_number_literals : Set(Str)
untyped_number_literals = Set.from_list(["e-int", "e-frac", "e-single-quote"])

## What a value is asked to be: the number itself, or what a `for` walks (a
## list literal of such numbers, a range of literals, or a name bound to
## either).
Asked : [Number, Items]

## How a plain name gets its type: from a definition's value, from a `for`
## that walks a value, or some other way (a parameter, an annotation, no
## binding found).
Binding : [Value(U64), Loop(U64), Unbound]

is_plain_name : Source.Node -> Bool
is_plain_name = |node| node.kind == "e-ident" and !(node.raw.contains("."))

has_parameter_named : Source.File, Source.Node, Str -> Bool
has_parameter_named = |file, lambda, name|
	lambda.kids.any(
		|kid| {
			args = Source.node_at(file, kid)
			args.kind == "args" and args.kids.any(|arg| is_parameter_named(file, arg, name))
		},
	)

is_parameter_named : Source.File, U64, Str -> Bool
is_parameter_named = |file, place, name| {
	pattern = Source.node_at(file, place)
	pattern.kind == "p-ident" and pattern.raw == name
}

## The binding of the plain name `name`, used at node `at`, that gives it
## its type. The binding that counts is the nearest one up the tree: in a
## block, the last definition before the statement holding the use; at the
## top level, any definition. A `var`'s type is its start's, so for a
## `$name` only its `var` counts, never a reassignment.
binding_of : Source.File, U64, Str -> Binding
binding_of = |file, at, name| {
	is_var = name.starts_with("$")
	var $child = at
	var $up = Source.node_at(file, at).parent
	while $up > 0 {
		scope = Source.node_at(file, $up)
		if scope.kind == "e-lambda" and has_parameter_named(file, scope, name) {
			return Unbound
		}
		if scope.kind == "s-for" and scope.kids.len() == 3 and $child == Source.kid(scope, 3) {
			if is_parameter_named(file, Source.kid(scope, 1), name) {
				return Loop(Source.kid(scope, 2))
			}
		}
		in_block = scope.kind == "statements" and scope.parent > 0 and Source.node_at(file, scope.parent).kind == "e-block"
		var $definition = 0
		var $annotated = Bool.False
		var $passed = Bool.False
		for kid in scope.kids {
			if in_block and kid == $child {
				$passed = Bool.True
			}
			if !($passed) {
				statement = Source.node_at(file, kid)
				if is_var {
					if statement.kind == "s-var" and statement.name == name and statement.kids.len() == 1 {
						$definition = kid
					}
				} else if Literals.defined_name(file, statement) == name {
					$definition = kid
				}
				if statement.kind == "s-type-anno" and statement.name == name {
					$annotated = Bool.True
				}
			}
		}
		if $definition > 0 {
			if $annotated {
				return Unbound
			}
			definition = Source.node_at(file, $definition)
			return Value(definition.kids.last() ?? 0)
		}
		$child = $up
		$up = scope.parent
	}
	Unbound
}

## `Literals.takes_literal_type`, for a number or for what a `for` walks, at
## most 8 bindings deep. One function for both, since each asks the other.
takes : Source.File, U64, Asked, U64 -> Bool
takes = |file, place, asked, depth|
	if depth > 8 {
		Bool.False
	} else if Literals.is_constant_numeric(file, place) {
		Bool.True
	} else {
		node = Source.node_at(file, place)
		if is_plain_name(node) {
			match binding_of(file, place, node.raw) {
				Unbound => Bool.False
				Loop(walked) => asked == Number and takes(file, walked, Items, depth + 1)
				Value(value) => takes(file, value, asked, depth + 1)
			}
		} else {
			match asked {
				Items =>
					node.kind == "e-list" and !(node.kids.is_empty()) and node.kids.all(|kid| takes(file, kid, Number, depth + 1))
				Number => field_takes(file, node, depth)
			}
		}
	}

## Whether a field access `r.a` reads a record literal's field that takes
## its type from number literals.
field_takes : Source.File, Source.Node, U64 -> Bool
field_takes = |file, node, depth|
	if node.kind == "e-field-access" and node.kids.len() == 2 {
		receiver = Source.kid_node(file, node, 1)
		segment = Source.kid_node(file, node, 2)
		if receiver.kind != "receiver" or receiver.kids.len() != 1 or segment.kind != "segment" {
			Bool.False
		} else {
			value_place = Source.kid(receiver, 1)
			value = Source.node_at(file, value_place)
			if !(is_plain_name(value)) {
				Bool.False
			} else {
				match binding_of(file, value_place, value.raw) {
					Value(bound) => {
						record = Source.node_at(file, bound)
						if record.kind != "e-record" {
							Bool.False
						} else {
							matching = record.kids.find_first(|kid| is_field_named(file, kid, segment.field))
							match matching {
								Ok(field_place) => takes(file, Source.kid(Source.node_at(file, field_place), 1), Number, depth + 1)
								Err(_) => Bool.False
							}
						}
					}
					_ => Bool.False
				}
			}
		}
	} else {
		Bool.False
	}

is_field_named : Source.File, U64, Str -> Bool
is_field_named = |file, place, name| {
	field = Source.node_at(file, place)
	field.kind == "field" and field.field == name and field.kids.len() == 1
}

cookbook/roc/rewrite_method_calls/Rewritten.roc, 168 lines

## A file's text written back with chosen calls turned: `Module.fn(first,
## rest...)` into `first.fn(rest...)`, or a peer method call back into a
## module call, `a.max(b)` into `U64.max(a, b)` (method_text.shale's
## `rewritten_text`). Every other byte is the file's own.
import Source

Rewritten := [].{

	## A call to turn, by its node: the module and function it calls, and
	## whether it is a peer method call turned back (`undo`).
	Turn : { node : U64, module_name : Str, fn : Str, undo : Bool }

	## The text written, the lines each turned call took in it, by the
	## call's node, and the line each node written starts on.
	Written : {
		text : Str,
		turned_lines : Dict(U64, { from_line : U64, to_line : U64 }),
		line_of_node : Dict(U64, U64),
	}

	## The file's text with every call in `turning` (by its node) turned. The
	## file node spans what roc-ast parsed; the bytes outside it, such as a
	## last newline, are kept.
	written : Source.File, Dict(U64, Rewritten.Turn) -> Rewritten.Written
	written = |file, turning| {
		root = Source.node_at(file, 1)
		start = {
			out: [],
			line: Source.line_of_offset(file, root.from),
			turned_lines: Dict.empty(),
			line_of_node: Dict.empty(),
		}
		done = emit_node(file, turning, start, 1, 0)
		before = Source.bytes_between(file, 1, root.from)
		after = file.bytes.drop_first(root.to - 1)
		{
			text: Str.from_utf8_lossy(before.concat(done.out).concat(after)),
			turned_lines: done.turned_lines,
			line_of_node: done.line_of_node,
		}
	}
}

## The text written so far, the line it ends on, and what is known of the
## turned calls and the nodes written.
Writer : {
	out : List(U8),
	line : U64,
	turned_lines : Dict(U64, { from_line : U64, to_line : U64 }),
	line_of_node : Dict(U64, U64),
}

## The node kinds a receiver can be without parentheses, as in `f(x).len()`
## or `"a".to_utf8()`. Any other (a number, a sum, a lambda, an `if`) is
## wrapped in them: `(a + b).to_str()`.
bare_receiver_kinds : Set(Str)
bare_receiver_kinds = Set.from_list(["e-ident", "e-apply", "e-method-call", "e-field-access", "e-string", "e-list", "e-record", "e-tuple", "e-tag"])

## `bytes` written, the line counted on past each newline.
emit_bytes : Writer, List(U8) -> Writer
emit_bytes = |writer, bytes| {
	newlines = bytes.count_if(|byte| byte == '\n')
	{ ..writer, out: writer.out.concat(bytes), line: writer.line + newlines }
}

emit : Writer, Str -> Writer
emit = |writer, text| emit_bytes(writer, text.to_utf8())

## The nodes that carry node `place`'s text: itself when it has a span, else
## its nearest descendants that do (`args` and `receiver` have none).
spanned_nodes : Source.File, U64 -> List(U64)
spanned_nodes = |file, place| {
	node = Source.node_at(file, place)
	if node.has_span {
		[place]
	} else {
		node.kids.join_map(|kid| spanned_nodes(file, kid))
	}
}

## Writes node `place`'s text, from byte `start` on. A call being turned is
## written as a method call (or a module call); any other node as it is,
## each kid that has a span written in its place by the same rule, so nested
## calls turn too. Spans may overlap (a type module's `type-mod` and its
## declaration both start at the type's name), so a kid is written from
## where the text so far ends, and one wholly before that is skipped.
emit_node : Source.File, Dict(U64, Rewritten.Turn), Writer, U64, U64 -> Writer
emit_node = |file, turning, writer, place, start| {
	node = Source.node_at(file, place)
	noted = { ..writer, line_of_node: writer.line_of_node.insert(place, writer.line) }
	match turning.get(place) {
		Ok(turn) => {
			from_line = noted.line
			done = if turn.undo {
				emit_undone(file, turning, noted, node, turn)
			} else {
				emit_turned(file, turning, noted, node, turn)
			}
			lines = { from_line, to_line: done.line }
			{ ..done, turned_lines: done.turned_lines.insert(place, lines) }
		}
		Err(_) => emit_as_written(file, turning, noted, node, start)
	}
}

## A module call written as a method call on its first argument.
emit_turned : Source.File, Dict(U64, Rewritten.Turn), Writer, Source.Node, Rewritten.Turn -> Writer
emit_turned = |file, turning, writer, node, turn| {
	args = node.kids.drop_first(1)
	first = args.first() ?? 0
	needs_parens = !(bare_receiver_kinds.contains(Source.node_at(file, first).kind))
	var $writer = writer
	if needs_parens {
		$writer = emit($writer, "(")
	}
	$writer = emit_node(file, turning, $writer, first, 0)
	if needs_parens {
		$writer = emit($writer, ")")
	}
	$writer = emit($writer, ".${turn.fn}(")
	var $comma = Bool.False
	for arg in args.drop_first(1) {
		if $comma {
			$writer = emit($writer, ", ")
		}
		$writer = emit_node(file, turning, $writer, arg, 0)
		$comma = Bool.True
	}
	emit($writer, ")")
}

## A peer method call turned back, `a.max(b)` written `U64.max(a, b)`.
emit_undone : Source.File, Dict(U64, Rewritten.Turn), Writer, Source.Node, Rewritten.Turn -> Writer
emit_undone = |file, turning, writer, node, turn| {
	receiver = Source.kid_node(file, node, 1)
	var $writer = emit(writer, "${turn.module_name}.${turn.fn}(")
	$writer = emit_node(file, turning, $writer, Source.kid(receiver, 1), 0)
	for arg in Source.kid_node(file, node, 2).kids {
		$writer = emit($writer, ", ")
		$writer = emit_node(file, turning, $writer, arg, 0)
	}
	emit($writer, ")")
}

## A node written as it is, from `start` or its own first byte, whichever is
## later, with its kids written in their places.
emit_as_written : Source.File, Dict(U64, Rewritten.Turn), Writer, Source.Node, U64 -> Writer
emit_as_written = |file, turning, writer, node, start| {
	var $at = if start > node.from {
		start
	} else {
		node.from
	}
	var $writer = writer
	for kid in node.kids {
		for spanned in spanned_nodes(file, kid) {
			span = Source.node_at(file, spanned)
			if span.to > $at {
				if span.from > $at {
					$writer = emit_bytes($writer, Source.bytes_between(file, $at, span.from))
				}
				$writer = emit_node(file, turning, $writer, spanned, $at)
				$at = span.to
			}
		}
	}
	emit_bytes($writer, Source.bytes_between(file, $at, node.to))
}
